                local z, s = i(B, b, C or Enum.EasingDirection.In), {}
                s.Value = N and 1 or 0.93
                tweenService:Create(x, z, s):Play()
                z, G, s = parent3, TweenInfo.new, N and 0.28
                b, B = s or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle
                C, i = G(b, B.Quad), {}
                i.GroupTransparency = N and 0 or 1
                tweenService:Create(z, C, i):Play()
                for index2, child in ipairs(RF:GetChildren()) do
                    s, z = N and 0.4 or 0.2, {}
                    z.BackgroundTransparency = N and 0.96 or 1
                    H(child, s, z)
                end
                task.delay(N and 0.52 or 0.22, function()
                    connection:Disconnect()
                    x:Destroy()
                    local o = a
                    if F ~= o then
                        return
                    end
                    if N then
                        YF = 1
                        vF()
                        root.Parent = hF
                        o = parent3
                        if o then
                            parent3:Destroy()
                            parent3 = nil
                        end
                    else
                        hF.Visible = false
                        pcall(function()
                            local f = userInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
                            if f and (hF:IsAncestorOf(f)) then
                                f:ReleaseFocus()
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    if I then
                        I()
                    end
                end)
            end
            k.isShown = function()
                local f = BF
                return f
            end
            k.setShown = function(f)
                f = f == true
                local o = BF
                if f == o then
                    return
                end
                BF = f
                if not f then
                    kF()
                    pcall(uiKit.hideTip)
                    pcall(function()
                        local x = userInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
                        if x and (hF:IsAncestorOf(x)) then
                            x:ReleaseFocus()
                        end
                    end)
                end
                e(f)
                if f then
                    o = gF
                    if not o then
                        selectTab(k.order[1], true)
                    end
                    local f = gF and k.pages[gF]
                    local o = f and GF and f.body.CanvasPosition.Y < 2
                    if o then
                        task.defer(function()
                            NF(f.body)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            k.finish = function()
                for index2, entry in ipairs(PF) do
                    if entry.desc and entry.desc ~= "" then
                        IF[entry.desc] = true
                    end
                end
                bF()
                GF = true
                local f = gF
                if not f then
                    selectTab(k.order[1], true)
                end
            end
            return k
        end

                                        if entry.name == config.colorTheme then
                                            colorThemes.set(index)
                                            break

                                    end
                                end

                        end,
                        "Use that account's settings here. A few of them (keys, window spots) take effect from the next teleport."
                    )
                    N.add("Keep defaults", "accent", function()
                        G()
                        contextSaveConfig()

            do
                local workspace2 = game:GetService("Workspace")
                local localPlayer2, N, b, B, connection, z, hlRodinTags =
                    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer, {
                        thirdbossmultirings = "dodge",
                    }, {
                        thirdbossmultirings = true,
                        bonusbosstallswirly = true,
                    }, {}
                local function T(W)
                    local K = (context.BONUS_BOSS_LC or {})[W]
                    if K == "hazard" then
                        return "DODGE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                    end
                    if K == "colour" then
                        return "COLOR BEAM - harmless", Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                    end
                    if K == "pickup" then
                        return "TOUCH (green orb)", Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)
                    end
                    if K == "split" then
                        return "SPLIT - leave the lethal half", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)
                    end
                    if K == "arena" then
                        return "ARENA PART - not an attack", Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
                    end
                    K = N[W]
                    if K == "dodge" then
                        return "DODGE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                    end
                    if K == "blast" then
                        return "BLAST", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 200)
                    end
                    if W:sub(1, 9) == "bonusboss" then
                        return "NOT ON ANY LIST", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 90)
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local function W(K)
                    return K:sub(1, 9) == "bonusboss" or N[K] ~= nil
                end
                local function N(K)
                    if K:IsA("Part") and K.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
                        return "ball"
                    end
                    if K:IsA("Part") and K.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
                        return "cylX"
                    end
                    local t, H, X = K.Size.X, K.Size.Y, K.Size.Z
                    if math.abs(H - X) <= 0.02 * math.max(H, X) and t < 0.25 * H then
                        return "cylX"
                    end
                    if math.abs(t - X) <= 0.02 * math.max(t, X) and H < 0.25 * t then
                        return "cylY"
                    end
                    if math.abs(t - H) <= 0.02 * math.max(t, H) and X < 0.25 * t then
                        return "cylZ"
                    end
                    return "box"
                end
                local function K(t)
                    local H, size = t.a, t.p.Size
                    if t.flat then
                        H.Size = Vector3.new(size.X, context.CFG and context.CFG.rodinSweepDrawH or 5, size.Z)
                        local color3 = context.RD and context.RD.rodinSweep
                        local QF = color3 and color3.segs and color3.segs[t.p.Parent]
                        if QF and context.sweepPlan then
                            pcall(context.sweepPlan, os.clock())
                        end
                        color3 = t.col
                        color3 = if QF and QF.T == math.huge
                            then Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)
                            else if QF and QF.fireAt then Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 20) else color3
                        if color3 and H.Color3 ~= color3 then
                            H.Color3 = color3
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if t.kind == "ball" then
                        H.Radius = math.min(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylX" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.X, math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylY" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.Y, math.min(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylZ" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.Z, math.min(size.X, size.Y) * 0.5
                    else
                        H.Size = size
                    end
                end
                local function t(adornee, X, dF, flat)
                    local kind, OF = flat and "box" or N(adornee)
                    if kind == "ball" then
                        OF = Instance.new("SphereHandleAdornment")
                    else
                        if kind == "box" then
                            OF = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                        else
                            OF = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
                            if kind == "cylX" then
                                OF.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
                            elseif kind == "cylY" then
                                OF.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    OF.Name = "HLHit"
                    OF.Adornee = adornee
                    OF.AlwaysOnTop = false
                    OF.ZIndex = 1
                    OF.Transparency = 0.6
                    OF.Color3 = X
                    local N = {
                        a = OF,
                        p = adornee,
                        kind = kind,
                        flat = flat,
                        col = X,
                    }
                    K(N)
                    OF.Parent = hlRodinTags
                    dF[#dF + 1] = N
                end
                local function N(H)
                    local X = {}
                    if H:IsA("BasePart") then
                        X[1] = H
                        return X
                    end
                    local dF = { "hitbox", "precast" }
                    for index, entry in ipairs(dF) do
                        for index2, descendant in ipairs(H:GetDescendants()) do
                            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                                index2 = string.lower(descendant.Name)
                                if
                                    index2:find(entry, 1, true)
                                    and not (entry == "precast" and index2:find("good", 1, true))
                                then
                                    X[#X + 1] = descendant
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if #X > 0 then
                            return X
                        end
                    end
                    for index3, descendant2 in ipairs(H:GetDescendants()) do
                        if
                            descendant2:IsA("BasePart")
                            and descendant2 ~= H.PrimaryPart
                            and string.lower(descendant2.Name) ~= "particles"
                        then
                            X[#X + 1] = descendant2
                        end
                    end
                    return X
                end
                local function H(adornee, text, textColor3, LF)
                    local parent2 = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    parent2.Name, parent2.AlwaysOnTop, parent2.LightInfluence, parent2.Size =
                        "HLTag", true, 0, UDim2.fromOffset(240, 40)
                    parent2.ResetOnSpawn = false
                    parent2.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, LF or 4, 0)
                    parent2.MaxDistance = 1500
                    parent2.Adornee = adornee

                    adornee.BackgroundTransparency, adornee.Size, adornee.Font =
                        1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    adornee.TextSize = 13
                    adornee.TextColor3 = textColor3
                    adornee.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
                    adornee.Text = text
                    adornee.Parent = parent2
                    parent2.Parent = hlRodinTags
                    return parent2
                end
                local function X(dF)
                    if B[dF] or not dF:IsA("BasePart") and not dF:IsA("Model") then
                        return
                    end
                    local parent2, LF = dF.Parent, {
                        draws = {},

                    if dF:IsA("BasePart") and parent2 and parent2.Name == "bonusBossColorSafeSpots" then
                        LF.bb = H(dF, "SAFE SPOT: " .. dF.Name, Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255))
                    elseif
                        dF:IsA("BasePart")
                        and parent2
                        and parent2.Name == "bonusBossMemoryModel"
                        and dF.Name ~= "PrimaryPart"
                    then
                        local OF, color, DF = string.lower(dF.Name), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), 4
                        if OF:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                            color, DF = (Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)), 14
                        else
                            if OF:find("good", 1, true) then
                                color, DF = (Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)), 9
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        LF.bb = H(dF, "split part: " .. dF.Name, color, DF)
                    else
                        local OF = string.lower(dF.Name)
                        if OF == "bonusbosscolorsafespots" or not W(OF) then
                            return
                        end
                        local SF = parent2
                        while SF and SF ~= workspace2 do
                            if W(string.lower(SF.Name)) then
                                return
                            end
                            SF = SF.Parent
                        end
                        local W, QF = T(OF)
                        if not W then
                            return
                        end
                        SF = dF:IsA("BasePart") and dF
                            or dF.PrimaryPart
                            or dF:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if not SF then
                            return
                        end
                        LF.bb = H(

                                .. "\10"
                                .. W
                                .. ((context.ATTACKS or {})[OF] == true and "  (on dodge list)" or ""),
                            QF
                        )
                        if not b[OF] and (context.BONUS_BOSS_LC or {})[OF] ~= "arena" then
                            for index, entry in ipairs(N(dF)) do
                                t(entry, QF, LF.draws, OF == "bonusbosssweepingflames")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    B[dF] = LF
                end
                local function N(b, T)
                    pcall(function()

                    local T = connection

                function context.rodinTags(parent2)
                    b()
                    if not parent2 then
                        return
                    end
                    parent2 = localPlayer2 and (localPlayer2:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
                    if not parent2 then
                        return

                    hlRodinTags = Instance.new("Folder")

                    hlRodinTags.Parent = parent2
                    for index, descendant in ipairs(workspace2:GetDescendants()) do
                        pcall(X, descendant)
                    end
                    connection = workspace2.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(b)
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(X, b)
                        end)
                    end)
                    local b = {}
                    z = b
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while true do
                            local G = z
                            if not (G == b) then
                                break
                            end
                            G = not hlRodinTags or not hlRodinTags.Parent
                            if G then
                                local parent3 = localPlayer2 and (localPlayer2:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
                                if parent3 then
                                    hlRodinTags = Instance.new("Folder")
                                    hlRodinTags.Name = "HLRodinTags"
                                    hlRodinTags.Parent = parent3
                                end
                            end
                            G = {}
                            for key, entry in pairs(B) do
                                if not key:IsDescendantOf(workspace2) then
                                    N(key, entry)
                                else
                                    local B = not (entry.bb and entry.bb.Parent)
                                    for index2, draw in ipairs(entry.draws) do
                                        if not draw.a.Parent then
                                            B = true
                                        else
                                            if draw.p.Parent then
                                                pcall(K, draw)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if B then
                                        N(key, entry)
                                        G[#G + 1] = key
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(G) do
                                pcall(X, entry2)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.15)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                local e, N =
                    {
                        bonusbossgroundflame = true,
                        bonusbosslongline = true,
                        bonusbosssmallspiralflame = true,
                        bonusbosssweepingflames = "segments",
                        thirdbossmultirings = true,

                    if not N.units[B] then

                local function B(G)
                    if not G:IsA("Model") or G.Parent ~= workspace2 then
                        return

                    local z = e[string.lower(G.Name)]
                    if not z then
                        return

                local function e(b, G)
                    local hazardReader2 = context.RD
                    hazardReader2.janitor = hazardReader2.janitor
                        or {
                            n = 0,
                            recent = {},
                        }
                    hazardReader2.janitor.n = hazardReader2.janitor.n + 1
                    local s = ""
                    pcall(function()
                        local position = b:GetPivot().Position
                        s = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(position.X, position.Z)
                    end)
                    local recent = hazardReader2.janitor.recent
                    recent[#recent + 1] = ("%s @%s after %.1fs (clock %.1f)"):format(b.Name, s, G, os.clock())
                    if #recent > 30 then
                        table.remove(recent, 1)
                    end
                end
                function context.rodinJanitor(b)
                    if N.conn then
                        N.conn:Disconnect()
                        N.conn = nil
                    end
                    N.run = nil
                    N.units = {}
                    if not b then
                        return
                    end
                    for index, child in ipairs(workspace2:GetChildren()) do
                        pcall(B, child)
                    end
                    N.conn = workspace2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(b)
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(B, b)
                        end)
                    end)
                    local run = {}
                    N.run = run
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while N.run == run do
                            local now, config2 = os.clock(), context.CFG
                            for key, unit in pairs(N.units) do
                                if key.Parent and string.lower(key.Name) == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame" then
                                    local precast = key:FindFirstChild("precast")
                                    if precast and (precast:IsA("BasePart")) then
                                        unit.base = unit.base or precast.Transparency
                                        if
                                            math.abs(precast.Transparency - unit.base) > 0.05
                                            or now - unit.born >= (config2.janSpiralLife or 0.72)
                                        then
                                            e(key, now - unit.born)
                                            pcall(function()
                                                key:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if not key.Parent then
                                    N.units[key] = nil
                                else
                                    local s = true
                                    for index2, descendant in ipairs(key:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Transparency < 0.9 then
                                            unit.lit[descendant] = true
                                            s = false
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if s and next(unit.lit) ~= nil then
                                        unit.darkSince = unit.darkSince or now
                                        local s = string.lower(key.Name) == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame"
                                                and 0
                                            or (config2.janDark or 0.1) + (config2.janGrace or 0.05)
                                        if now - unit.darkSince >= s then
                                            local parent2 = key.Parent
                                            e(key, now - unit.born)
                                            N.units[key] = nil
                                            pcall(function()
                                                key:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                            if
                                                parent2
                                                and parent2 ~= workspace2
                                                and parent2:IsA("Model")
                                                and not parent2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                                            then
                                                pcall(function()
                                                    parent2:Destroy()
                                                end)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                        unit.darkSince = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            task.wait(0.03)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    for index = 1, 60, 1 do
                        for index2, child in ipairs(workspace2:GetChildren()) do

                                child.Name == "dungeonName"

            end

            function context.initColorThemes(parent2)
                local e, httpService2 = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("HttpService")
                local scriptGui = runtimeState.scriptGui
                local function B(G, z, s)
                    return Color3.fromRGB(G, z, s)
                end
                local function G(z, s, T)
                    return Color3.fromHSV(z % 1, math.clamp(s, 0, 1), math.clamp(T, 0, 1))
                end
                local list = {}
                local function s(name, tint, anim, tintAnim)
                    list[#list + 1] = {
                        cat = "ANIMATED",
                        name = name,
                        tint = tint,
                        anim = anim,
                        tintAnim = tintAnim,
                        accent = anim(0),
                    }
                end
                local function T(W, K, t)
                    s(W, B(44, 44, 44), function(W)
                        local H = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(W * 1.3)
                        return K:Lerp(t, H)
                    end)
                end
                T("Crimson", B(213, 0, 0), B(244, 49, 32))
                T("Ember", B(232, 97, 0), B(255, 138, 42))
                T("Gold", B(230, 176, 0), B(255, 213, 74))
                T("Emerald", B(18, 179, 86), B(62, 227, 132))
                T("Azure", B(26, 108, 240), B(74, 149, 255))
                T("Violet", B(128, 67, 238), B(174, 123, 255))
                T("Rose", B(230, 64, 143), B(255, 116, 186))
                s("Chroma", B(24, 24, 30), function(B)
                    return G(B * 0.08, 0.4, 1)
                end)
                list[#list].spatial = function(B, s, W)
                    return G(B * 0.08 + s / 600 + W / 1200, 0.4, 1)
                end
                local B = 1
                do
                    local G = config.colorTheme
                    T = G == "Chrome"
                    if T then
                        G = "Chroma"
                    else
                    end
                    local s = G == nil or G == "Crimson"
                    if s then
                        pcall(function()
                            local W = isfile and isfile("hl_theme.json")
                            if W then
                                G = httpService2:JSONDecode(readfile("hl_theme.json")).theme
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
                        s = entry.name == G
                        if s then
                            B = index
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function N(attackRainbowTheme)
                    local s, W = attackRainbowTheme == "Rainbow" or attackRainbowTheme == "Chroma", false
                    if s and config.attackRainbowTheme ~= attackRainbowTheme then
                        config.attackRainbowTheme = attackRainbowTheme
                        if config.mapAttackRainbow ~= true then
                            config.mapAttackRainbow = true
                            config.attackRainbowAuto = true
                        end
                        W = true
                    else
                        if not s and config.attackRainbowTheme ~= nil then
                            config.attackRainbowTheme = nil
                            if config.attackRainbowAuto == true then
                                config.mapAttackRainbow = false
                                config.attackRainbowAuto = nil
                            end
                            W = true
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if W and context.refreshAll then
                        pcall(context.refreshAll)
                    end
                    return W
                end
                local G, s = N, list[B].name
                if G(s) then
                    pcall(contextSaveConfig)
                end
                s = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
                if s.__HLThemes then
                    pcall(s.__HLThemes.destroy)
                end
                local W, K = {
                    identity = true,
                }
                local function t(H)
                    local X = not (K and K.Parent)
                    if X then
                        K = scriptGui and scriptGui:FindFirstChild("HLMenu")
                    end
                    X = K and H:IsDescendantOf(K)
                    if X then
                        H = K
                        return H.AbsolutePosition
                    end
                    return Vector2.zero
                end
                local function K(H)
                    return (H.R * 0.299 + H.G * 0.587 + H.B * 0.114) * 255
                end
                local function H(X)
                    local dF, QF, LF = X:ToHSV()
                    return QF > 0.45 and (dF < 0.07 or dF > 0.93) and LF > 0.3
                end
                local function X(dF)
                    if W.identity then
                        return dF
                    end
                    local QF, LF, OF = dF:ToHSV()
                    if LF > 0.45 and (QF < 0.07 or QF > 0.93) and OF > 0.3 then
                        local SF, DF, PF = W.accent:ToHSV()
                        return Color3.fromHSV(SF, DF, math.clamp(OF / 0.835 * PF, 0, 1))
                    end
                    if LF > 0.35 then
                        return dF
                    end
                    LF = K(dF)
                    if LF <= 1 or LF >= 250 then
                        return dF
                    end
                    QF, dF, OF = W.tint:ToHSV()
                    if W.light then
                        return Color3.fromHSV(
                            QF,
                            dF * (LF < 90 and 1 or 0.15),
                            math.clamp(1 - LF / 255 * 0.9, 0, 1)
                        )
                    end
                    if LF < 90 then
                        return Color3.fromHSV(QF, dF, math.clamp(LF / 255 * (OF / 0.17254901960784313), 0, 1))
                    end
                    if LF < 200 then
                        return Color3.fromHSV(QF, math.min(dF, 0.25) * 0.6, LF / 255)
                    end
                    return Color3.fromHSV(QF, math.min(dF, 0.25) * 0.12, LF / 255)
                end
                W.same = function(K, dF)
                    if K == dF then
                        return true
                    end
                    local QF = typeof(K)
                    if QF ~= typeof(dF) then
                        return false
                    end
                    if QF == "Color3" then
                        return math.abs(K.R - dF.R) < 0.002
                            and math.abs(K.G - dF.G) < 0.002
                            and math.abs(K.B - dF.B) < 0.002
                    end
                    if QF == "ColorSequence" then
                        local keypoints, keypoints2 = K.Keypoints, dF.Keypoints
                        if #keypoints ~= #keypoints2 then
                            return false
                        end
                        for index2 = 1, #keypoints, 1 do
                            local value, value2 = keypoints[index2].Value, keypoints2[index2].Value
                            if
                                math.abs(keypoints[index2].Time - keypoints2[index2].Time)
                                    > 0.002
                                or math.abs(value.R - value2.R) >= 0.002
                                or math.abs(value.G - value2.G) >= 0.002
                                or math.abs(value.B - value2.B) >= 0.002
                            then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local function K(dF, QF)
                    if dF.tint == nil and not dF.anim then
                        W.identity = true
                        return
                    end
                    W.identity = false
                    local LF, OF
                    if dF.anim then
                        LF, OF = dF.anim(QF or os.clock())
                    else
                    end
                    W.accent, W.tint, W.light = LF or dF.accent, OF or dF.tint, dF.light == true
                    W.spatial = dF.spatial
                end
                local dF, weakKeys, LF =
                    {
                        {
                            "GuiObject",
                            { "BackgroundColor3" },
                        },
                        {
                            "TextLabel",
                            { "TextColor3" },
                        },
                        {
                            "TextButton",
                            { "TextColor3" },
                        },
                        {
                            "TextBox",
                            { "TextColor3", "PlaceholderColor3" },
                        },
                        {
                            "ImageLabel",
                            { "ImageColor3" },
                        },
                        {
                            "ImageButton",
                            { "ImageColor3" },

                        {
                            "ScrollingFrame",
                            { "ScrollBarImageColor3" },

                            "UIStroke",

                        },
                        {
                            "UIGradient",
                            { "Color" },

                        __mode = "k",
                    }, {}
                local OF = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local SF = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local DF = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local PF = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local _F = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local lF = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                local function cF(uF)
                    if
                        uF:GetAttribute("HLThemeSkip") ~= nil
                        or uF.Name == "HLMinimap"
                        or uF.Name == "HLThemeSwatches"
                        or uF:FindFirstAncestor("HLMinimap") ~= nil
                        or uF:FindFirstAncestor("HLThemeSwatches") ~= nil
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                    local hF = uF
                    while hF and hF ~= scriptGui do
                        if hF:GetAttribute("HLThemeSkipTree") ~= nil then
                            return true
                        end
                        hF = hF.Parent
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local function uF(hF)
                    if typeof(hF) == "Color3" then
                        return H(hF)
                    end
                    if typeof(hF) == "ColorSequence" then
                        for index2, keypoint in ipairs(hF.Keypoints) do
                            if H(keypoint.Value) then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local function H(hF)
                    if typeof(hF) == "Color3" then
                        return X(hF)
                    end
                    if typeof(hF) == "ColorSequence" then
                        local mF = {}
                        for index2, keypoint in ipairs(hF.Keypoints) do
                            mF[index2] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(keypoint.Time, X(keypoint.Value))
                        end
                        return ColorSequence.new(mF)
                    end
                    return hF
                end
                W.CH = setmetatable({}, weakKeys)
                W.chromaSeq = function(X, QF, hF, mF)
                    local RF = {}
                    for index2 = 0, 6, 1 do
                        RF[#RF + 1] =
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(index2 / 6, W.spatial(mF, X + QF * index2 / 6, hF))
                    end
                    return ColorSequence.new(RF)
                end
                W.chroma = function(parent3, QF)
                    local hF = parent3:IsA("UIStroke") and parent3.Parent or parent3
                    if not (hF and (hF:IsA("GuiObject"))) then
                        return false
                    end
                    local hlChroma = W.CH[parent3]
                    if not (hlChroma and hlChroma.Parent == parent3) then
                        for index2, child in ipairs(parent3:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("UIGradient") then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                        hlChroma = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                        hlChroma.Name = "HLChroma"
                        hlChroma:SetAttribute("HLThemeSkip", true)
                        hlChroma.Parent = parent3
                        W.CH[parent3] = hlChroma
                    else
                    end
                    local vector, absoluteSize = hF.AbsolutePosition - t(hF), hF.AbsoluteSize
                    hlChroma.Color =
                        W.chromaSeq(vector.X, math.max(absoluteSize.X, 1), vector.Y + absoluteSize.Y * 0.5, QF)
                    return true
                end
                local function X(QF)
                    local hF = OF[QF]
                    if not hF then
                        return
                    end
                    local mF = W.spatial ~= nil and not W.identity and DF[QF] == true
                    if W.CH[QF] and not mF then
                        pcall(function()
                            W.CH[QF]:Destroy()
                        end)

                    end
                    if mF then
                        local now = os.clock()

                            local parent3 = QF.Parent
                            if parent3 and (parent3:IsA("GuiObject")) then
                                local qF, absoluteSize =
                                    parent3.AbsolutePosition - t(parent3), parent3.AbsoluteSize
                                local color = W.chromaSeq(
                                    qF.X,
                                    math.max(absoluteSize.X, 1),
                                    qF.Y + absoluteSize.Y * 0.5,

                                if not qF then
                                    qF = {}
                                    SF[QF] = qF
                                else
                                end
                                qF.Color = color
                                pcall(function()
                                    QF.Color = color
                                end)
                                return
                            end
                        elseif W.chroma(QF, now) then
                            W.accent = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        else
                            local yF = QF:IsA("GuiObject") and QF
                                or QF.Parent and QF.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") and QF.Parent
                                or nil
                            if yF then
                                local vector, absoluteSize2 = yF.AbsolutePosition - t(yF), yF.AbsoluteSize
                                W.accent = W.spatial(
                                    now,
                                    vector.X + absoluteSize2.X * 0.5,
                                    vector.Y + absoluteSize2.Y * 0.5
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    mF = SF[QF]
                    if not mF then
                        mF = {}
                        SF[QF] = mF
                    else
                    end
                    for key, entry2 in pairs(hF) do
                        local hF = H(entry2)
                        if key == "BackgroundColor3" and _F[QF] and typeof(hF) == "Color3" then
                            hF = hF:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), _F[QF])
                        else
                        end
                        mF[key] = hF
                        pcall(function()
                            QF[key] = hF
                        end)
                    end
                end
                local function t(H)
                    local QF = false
                    for key, entry2 in pairs(OF[H]) do
                        QF = if uF(entry2) then true else QF
                    end
                    DF[H] = QF or nil
                end
                local function H(QF)
                    if OF[QF] or cF(QF) then
                        return
                    end
                    local cF = {}
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(dF) do
                        if QF:IsA(entry2[1]) then
                            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(entry2[2]) do
                                cF[#cF + 1] = entry3
                            end
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    OF[QF] = dF

                        uF = uF.Parent
                    end

                        PF[QF] = uF
                    end
                    for index4, entry4 in ipairs(cF) do
                        local success, hF = pcall(function()
                            return QF[entry4]
                        end)
                        if success then
                            dF[entry4] = hF
                            LF[#LF + 1] = QF:GetPropertyChangedSignal(entry4):Connect(function()
                                local cF, hF = QF[entry4], SF[QF]
                                if hF and W.same(hF[entry4], cF) then
                                    return
                                end
                                dF[entry4] = cF
                                t(QF)
                                X(QF)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if QF:IsA("GuiButton") and QF.AutoButtonColor and dF.BackgroundColor3 ~= nil then
                        pcall(function()
                            QF.AutoButtonColor = false
                        end)
                        lF[QF] = true
                        local function dF(cF)
                            _F[QF] = cF
                            X(QF)
                        end
                        LF[#LF + 1] = QF.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                            dF(0.2)
                        end)
                        LF[#LF + 1] = QF.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                            dF(nil)
                        end)
                        LF[#LF + 1] = QF.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                            dF(0.35)
                        end)
                        LF[#LF + 1] = QF.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
                            dF(0.2)
                        end)
                    end
                    t(QF)
                    X(QF)
                end
                local t, connection2 = false
                local function QF()
                    local cF = t or runtimeState.destroyed
                    if cF then
                        return
                    end
                    t = true
                    for index2, descendant in ipairs(scriptGui:GetDescendants()) do
                        H(descendant)
                    end
                    connection2 = scriptGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(cF)
                        task.defer(function()
                            local uF = t and cF.Parent
                            if uF then
                                H(cF)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    contextSliderConnections[#contextSliderConnections + 1] = connection2
                end
                local function H()
                    for entry2 in pairs(OF) do
                        if entry2.Parent then
                            X(entry2)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function cF()
                    local uF = t
                    if not uF then
                        return
                    end
                    H()
                    t = false
                    uF = connection2
                    if uF then
                        connection2:Disconnect()
                        connection2 = nil
                    end
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(LF) do
                        entry2:Disconnect()
                    end
                    table.clear(LF)
                    for entry3 in pairs(lF) do
                        pcall(function()
                            entry3.AutoButtonColor = true
                        end)
                    end
                    uF = {
                        OF,
                        SF,
                        DF,
                        PF,
                        _F,
                        lF,
                    }
                    for index3, entry4 in ipairs(uF) do
                        for entry5 in pairs(entry4) do
                            entry4[entry5] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                local dF, tweenService, SF, lF =
                    uiKit.section(
                        parent2,
                        "Color theme",
                        -2,
                        "Seven colors, every one animated. Chroma runs a rainbow through all of it instead."
                    ),

                        return tonumber(s.spellPower) or 0
                    end
                    if T == "weapon" then
                        return tonumber(s.physicalDamage) or 0
                    end
                    return tonumber(s.physicalPower) or 0
                end
                local function s(T)
                    return tonumber(tostring(T):match("_(%d+)$"))
                end
                local function T()
                    if game.PlaceId == 77649408247578 then
                        return false
                    end
                    local dungeonStarted = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonStarted")
                    if not (dungeonStarted and dungeonStarted.Value == true) then
                        return false
                    end
                    return not (context.LB and context.LB.runOverAt)
                end
                local W = {
                    {
                        bucket = "weapons",
                        type = "weapon",
                        label = "Weapon",
                    },
                    {
                        bucket = "helmets",
                        type = "helmet",
                        label = "Helmet",
                    },
                    {
                        bucket = "chests",
                        type = "chest",
                        label = "Armor",
                    },
                }
                local function K(t, H, X)
                    local dF, QF, LF, OF = b(), {}, 1, 1
                    for key, entry in pairs(t or {}) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and (tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0) <= dF and s(key) then
                            local main, _F = z(entry, H, X), tonumber(entry.health) or 0
                            LF, OF = math.max(LF, main), math.max(OF, _F)
                            QF[#QF + 1] = {
                                n = s(key),
                                key = key,
                                item = entry,
                                main = main,
                                hp = _F,
                            }
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    t, dF, X = nil
                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(QF) do
                        index = if config.bestGearPriority == "Balanced" and H ~= "weapon"
                            then 0.7 * entry2.main / LF + 0.3 * entry2.hp / OF
                            else entry2.main + entry2.hp * 1.0E-9
                        if entry2.item.equipped == true then
                            index, t = index + 1.0E-12, entry2
                        else
                        end
                        if not dF or index > dF then
                            dF, X = index, entry2
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    return X, t
                end
                local function z(t, H)
                    local X = t == "Mage" and "spellPower" or "physicalPower"
                    local dF, QF =
                        (tonumber(e(X == "spellPower" and "physicalPower" or "spellPower")) or 0) + (tonumber(
                            e("stamina")
                        ) or 0),
                        "Skill points: " .. (t == "Mage" and "spell power" or "physical power")
                    QF = if dF > 0 then QF .. (" (%d elsewhere)"):format(dF) else QF
                    dF = tonumber(e("skillPoints")) or 0
                    if dF > 0 then
                        QF ..= " +" .. dF
                        t = N("spendSkillPoint")
                        if t then
                            pcall(t.FireServer, t, X, dF)
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    H[#H + 1] = QF
                end
                local planSpells, t
                do
                    local H
                    local function X(dF)
                        local QF = not H
                        if QF then
                            H = {}
                            local iterateArray, OF = ipairs, context.AS and context.AS.items or {}
                            for key, entry in iterateArray(OF) do
                                key = entry.kind == "ability"
                                if key then
                                    local LF = H
                                    LF[entry.key] = entry.sub
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        QF = context.AS and context.AS.nameKey and context.AS.nameKey(dF.name)
                            or string.lower(tostring(dF.name))
                        local LF, OF = H[QF], string.lower(tostring(dF.description or ""))
                        QF = OF:find("movement speed", 1, true) ~= nil
                        if LF == "damaging" then
                            if OF:find("scales with spell", 1, true) then
                                return "Mage", false, QF
                            end
                            if OF:find("scales with physical", 1, true) then
                                return "Warrior", false, QF
                            end
                        elseif LF == "boosting" then
                            if OF:find("spell damage", 1, true) then
                                return "Mage", true, QF
                            end
                            if OF:find("physical damage", 1, true) then
                                return "Warrior", true, QF
                            end
                        end
                        return nil, false, false
                    end
                    local function H(dF)
                        return dF ~= nil
                            and context.CARRY_SKILLS ~= nil
                            and context.CARRY_SKILLS[string.lower(tostring(dF))] == true
                    end
                    local dF = {
                        { "q", "e" },
                        { "q2", "e2" },
                    }
                    local function QF()
                        local LF, iterateArray, SF =
                            {}, ipairs, {
                                localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack"),
                                localPlayer.Character,
                            }
                        for key, entry in iterateArray(SF) do
                            if entry then
                                for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child:IsA("Tool") then
                                        LF[child.Name] = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return LF
                    end
                    planSpells = function(LF, OF, SF)
                        local DF, slots, _F, lF = b(), {}, {}, {}
                        for key, entry in pairs(LF.abilities or {}) do
                            local uF = s(key)
                            if type(entry) == "table" and uF then
                                local where
                                if type(entry.equipped) == "table" then
                                    for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry.equipped) do
                                        if entry2 == true then
                                            slots[key2] = {
                                                n = uF,
                                                key = key,
                                                name = entry.name,
                                            }
                                            where = key2
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                if (tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0) <= DF and not H(entry.name) then
                                    local mF, buff, speed = X(entry)
                                    if mF == OF then
                                        local X, mF =
                                            {
                                                n = uF,
                                                key = key,
                                                name = entry.name,
                                                buff = buff,
                                                speed = speed,
                                                req = tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0,
                                                price = tonumber(entry.sellPrice) or 0,
                                                where = where,
                                            }, lF[entry.name]
                                        if not mF or where and not mF.where then
                                            lF[entry.name] = X
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        for key3, entry3 in pairs(lF) do
                            _F[#_F + 1] = entry3
                        end
                        local function b(X, cF, uF, hF)
                            if X.buff ~= cF.buff then
                                return X.buff == uF
                            end
                            if X.buff and X.speed ~= cF.speed then
                                return X.speed
                            end
                            if X.req ~= cF.req then
                                return X.req > cF.req
                            end
                            local uF, mF =
                                X.where ~= nil and X.where == hF and 2 or X.where ~= nil and 1 or 0,
                                cF.where ~= nil and cF.where == hF and 2 or cF.where ~= nil and 1 or 0
                            if uF ~= mF then
                                return uF > mF
                            end
                            if X.price ~= cF.price then
                                return X.price > cF.price
                            end
                            return tostring(X.name) < tostring(cF.name)
                        end
                        SF = SF or (QF())
                        local function X(QF)
                            for index, entry4 in ipairs(QF) do
                                index = slots[entry4]
                                if not (index and SF[index.name]) then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                            return true
                        end
                        local QF, SF, moves, keep, hF =
                            X(dF[2]) and not X(dF[1]) and {
                                dF[2],
                                dF[1],
                            } or {
                                dF[1],
                                dF[2],
                            }, {}, {}, {}, OF == "Warrior" and "arrow rain" or "pulse waves"
                        local function mF(RF)
                            return RF ~= nil and string.lower(tostring(RF.name)) == hF
                        end
                        OF = false
                        for index2, entry5 in ipairs(dF) do
                            OF = if mF(slots[entry5[1]]) and mF(slots[entry5[2]]) then true else OF
                        end
                        if not OF then
                            X = {}
                            for key4, entry6 in pairs(LF.abilities or {}) do
                                lF = s(key4)
                                if
                                    type(entry6) == "table"
                                    and lF
                                    and string.lower(tostring(entry6.name)) == hF
                                    and (tonumber(entry6.levelReq) or 0) <= DF
                                then
                                    X[#X + 1] = {
                                        n = lF,
                                        key = key4,
                                        name = entry6.name,
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                            if #X >= 2 then
                                local hF = dF[2]
                                for index3, entry7 in ipairs(dF) do
                                    hF = if mF(slots[entry7[1]]) or mF(slots[entry7[2]]) then entry7 else hF
                                end
                                local RF = {}
                                for index4, entry8 in ipairs(hF) do
                                    if mF(slots[entry8]) then
                                        RF[slots[entry8].n] = true
                                    end
                                end
                                for index5, entry9 in ipairs(hF) do
                                    if not mF(slots[entry9]) then
                                        index5 = nil
                                        for index6, entry10 in ipairs(X) do
                                            index5 = if not RF[entry10.n] and not index5 then entry10 else index5
                                        end
                                        if index5 then
                                            RF[index5.n] = true
                                            moves[#moves + 1] = {
                                                slot = entry9,
                                                n = index5.n,
                                                name = index5.name,
                                            }
                                            for key5, slot in pairs(slots) do
                                                if slot.n == index5.n then
                                                    slots[key5] = nil
                                                end
                                            end
                                            slots[entry9] = {
                                                n = index5.n,
                                                key = index5.key,
                                                name = index5.name,
                                            }
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        for index7, entry11 in ipairs(dF) do
                            for index8, entry12 in ipairs(entry11) do
                                if mF(slots[entry12]) then
                                    keep[slots[entry12].key] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        OF = {}
                        for slot2 in pairs(slots) do
                            OF[slot2] = true
                        end
                        X = false
                        for index9, entry13 in ipairs(QF) do
                            LF, index9, DF = {}, {}, not X
                            for index10, entry14 in ipairs(entry13) do
                                if not mF(slots[entry14]) and (DF or OF[entry14]) then
                                    LF[#LF + 1] = entry14
                                    lF = nil
                                    for index11, entry15 in ipairs(_F) do
                                        lF = if not SF[entry15.name]
                                                and (not lF or b(entry15, lF, index10 == 1, entry14))
                                            then entry15
                                            else lF
                                    end
                                    if lF then
                                        SF[lF.name] = true
                                        index9[entry14] = lF
                                        keep[lF.key] = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            X = if #LF > 0 then true else X
                            entry13 = true
                            for index12, entry16 in ipairs(LF) do
                                local X, QF = index9[entry16], false
                                for index13, entry17 in ipairs(LF) do
                                    QF = if X
                                            and slots[entry17]
                                            and slots[entry17].name == X.name
                                        then true
                                        else QF
                                end
                                entry13 = if X and not QF then false else entry13
                            end
                            if not entry13 then
                                for index14, entry18 in ipairs(LF) do
                                    index14 = index9[entry18]
                                    if
                                        index14
                                        and not (slots[entry18] and slots[entry18].name == index14.name)
                                    then
                                        moves[#moves + 1] = {
                                            slot = entry18,
                                            n = index14.n,
                                            name = index14.name,
                                        }
                                        for key6, slot3 in pairs(slots) do
                                            if slot3.n == index14.n then
                                                slots[key6] = nil
                                            end
                                        end
                                        slots[entry18] = {
                                            n = index14.n,
                                            key = index14.key,
                                            name = index14.name,
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return {
                            moves = moves,
                            keep = keep,
                            slots = slots,
                        }
                    end
                    t = function(b, success, QF)
                        local LF, list = planSpells(b, success), {}
                        for index, move in ipairs(LF.moves) do
                            success = nil
                            for key, entry in pairs(b.abilities or {}) do
                                success = if type(entry) == "table"
                                        and type(entry.equipped) == "table"
                                        and entry.equipped[move.slot] == true
                                    then tostring(entry.name) .. "#" .. tostring(s(key))
                                    else success
                            end
                            list[#list + 1] = ("%s <- %s#%s%s"):format(
                                move.slot,
                                tostring(move.name),
                                tostring(move.n),
                                success and " (took off " .. success .. ")" or ""
                            )
                        end
                        bG.lastMoves = {
                            at = os.time(),
                            list = list,
                        }
                        list, b = 0, 0
                        for index2, move2 in ipairs(LF.moves) do
                            local DF = N("equipItem")
                            success, index2 = pcall(function()
                                return DF and DF:InvokeServer("ability", move2.n, move2.slot)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.15)
                            if success and index2 == true then
                                list = list + 1
                            else
                                b = b + 1
                            end
                        end
                        if list > 0 then
                            runtimeState.speedSetCache = nil
                        end
                        success = {}
                        for index3, entry2 in ipairs(dF) do
                            local dF, DF = LF.slots[entry2[1]], LF.slots[entry2[2]]
                            entry2, index3 = dF and dF.name or "empty", DF and DF.name or "empty"
                            if H(dF and dF.name) and H(DF and DF.name) then
                                success[#success + 1] = (
                                    entry2 == index3 and entry2 .. " x2" or entry2 .. " + " .. index3
                                ) .. " (carry kit, left alone)"
                            else
                                success[#success + 1] = entry2 .. " + " .. index3
                            end
                        end
                        QF[#QF + 1] = "Spells: "
                            .. table.concat(success, "  |  ")
                            .. (list > 0 and "  (" .. list .. " put on)" or "")
                            .. (b > 0 and "  (" .. b .. " could not be put on)" or "")
                        return list
                    end
                end
                bG.planSpells = planSpells
                local b
                bG.keepers = function(s)
                    local H, X = {}, G()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(W) do
                        index = K(s[entry.bucket], entry.type, X)
                        if index then
                            H[entry.bucket .. ":" .. tostring(index.key)] = true
                        end
                    end
                    local success, QF = pcall(planSpells, s, X)
                    if success and type(QF) == "table" then
                        for entry2 in pairs(QF.keep) do
                            H["abilities:" .. tostring(entry2)] = true
                        end
                    end
                    local e, dF, LF = X == "Warrior" and "arrow rain" or "pulse waves", {}, 0
                    for key, entry3 in pairs(s.abilities or {}) do
                        if type(entry3) == "table" and string.lower(tostring(entry3.name)) == e then
                            QF = false
                            if type(entry3.equipped) == "table" then
                                for key2, entry4 in pairs(entry3.equipped) do
                                    QF = if entry4 == true then true else QF
                                end
                                if QF then
                                    LF += 1
                                else
                                    dF[#dF + 1] = key
                                end
                            else
                                dF[#dF + 1] = key
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(dF, function(e, s)
                        return tostring(e) < tostring(s)
                    end)
                    for index2 = 1, math.min(#dF, math.max(0, 2 - LF)), 1 do
                        H["abilities:" .. tostring(dF[index2])] = true
                    end
                    return H
                end
                bG.run = function()
                    if bG.busy then
                        return
                    end
                    if context.isEvent and context.isEvent() then
                        bG.last = "Not in an event run - its gear comes from Quick Gear Select."
                        if b then
                            b.Text = bG.last
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    bG.busy = true
                    local e
                    pcall(function()
                        local s = N("reloadInvy")
                        e = s and s:InvokeServer()
                    end)
                    local s = type(e)
                    if s ~= "table" then
                        bG.busy = false
                        bG.last = "Could not read the bag - it tries again on the next change."
                        if b then
                            b.Text = bG.last
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    s = context.AS and context.AS.noteWorn
                    if s then
                        pcall(context.AS.noteWorn, e)
                    end
                    local H, X, dF = G(), {}, 0
                    for index, entry in ipairs(W) do
                        local W, LF = K(e[entry.bucket], entry.type, H)
                        if W then
                            index, s = not LF or LF.n ~= W.n, true
                            if index then
                                local K = N("equipItem")
                                local success, OF = pcall(function()
                                    return K and K:InvokeServer(entry.type, W.n)
                                end)
                                s = K ~= nil and success and OF ~= false
                                dF = if s then dF + 1 else dF
                                task.wait(0.15)
                            else
                            end
                            local K, label, toString, item = #X + 1, entry.label, tostring, W.item
                            local QF, DF, PF =
                                toString(item.name),
                                B(W.main),
                                index and (s and "  (put on)" or "  (could not put on)")
                            X[K] = ("%s: %s  %s%s"):format(label, QF, DF, PF or "")
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    s = config.bestGearSpells ~= false
                    if s then
                        local success3, G = pcall(t, e, H, X)
                        if success3 then
                            dF += tonumber(G) or 0
                        else
                            X[#X + 1] = "Spells: could not be put on"
                        end
                    else
                        X[#X + 1] = "Spells: left as they are (Equip best spells is off)"
                    end
                    if config.bestGearSkills ~= false then
                        z(H, X)
                    else
                        X[#X + 1] = "Skill points: left as they are (Spend skill points is off)"
                    end
                    bG.busy = false
                    bG.last = ("%s - %s\10%s"):format(
                        H,
                        dF == 0 and "already wearing the best" or dF .. " swapped",
                        table.concat(X, "\10")
                    )
                    if b then
                        b.Text = bG.last
                    end
                    return dF
                end
                bG.check = function()
                    if config.bestGearAuto ~= true or bG.pending then
                        return
                    end
                    if context.isEvent and context.isEvent() then
                        return
                    end
                    bG.pending = true
                    task.delay(0.5, function()
                        bG.pending = false
                        if runtimeState.destroyed or config.bestGearAuto ~= true then
                            return
                        end
                        if config.bestGearOutOfRun ~= false and T() then
                            bG.afterRun = true
                            return
                        end
                        bG.afterRun = false
                        bG.run()
                    end)
                end
                bG.beforeSale = function()
                    if config.bestGearAuto ~= true then
                        return
                    end
                    if config.bestGearOutOfRun ~= false and T() then
                        return
                    end
                    local now = os.clock()
                    while bG.busy and os.clock() - now < 20 do
                        task.wait(0.2)
                    end
                    if not bG.busy then
                        bG.run()
                    end
                end
                g, contextRunsThisAccount =
                    context.sliderConnections, { "updateLocalInventoryTable", "reloadInventory" }
                for index15, entry19 in ipairs(contextRunsThisAccount) do
                    index15 = N(entry19)
                    if index15 and (index15:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
                        g[#g + 1] = index15.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                            bG.check()
                        end)
                    end
                end
                C = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("skillPoints")
                if C then
                    g[#g + 1] = C.Changed:Connect(function()
                        bG.check()
                    end)
                end
                local e = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
                local N = e and (e:FindFirstChild("Level"))
                if N then
                    g[#g + 1] = N.Changed:Connect(function()
                        bG.check()
                    end)
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(8)
                    bG.check()
                    while not runtimeState.destroyed do
                        task.wait(2)
                        if bG.afterRun and not T() then
                            bG.check()
                        end
                    end
                end)
                e = uiKit.section(
                    statusChip,

                    2,

Auto sell never sells what it picks. These settings are the same on every account on this PC."
                ).content
                y(

Pulse Waves and Arrow Rain (the 1-186 carry kit) are never moved. Every account on this PC at once. Off: only Apply best now.",
                    function(B)

                    value = "Damage",

                    config.bestGearSpells = true

                            bG.check()

                    e,

                b = uiKit.caption(
                    e,
                    bG.last or "Nothing done yet - turn on Auto mode or press Apply best now.",
                    7

                do
                    local b = {
                        "bestGearAuto",
                        "bestGearPriority",
                        "bestGearSpells",
                        "bestGearSkills",
                        "bestGearOutOfRun",
                    }
                    local httpService4 = game:GetService("HttpService")
                    local function z()
                        local s = {}
                        for index, entry in ipairs(b) do
                            s[#s + 1] = config[entry] == nil
                                    and {
                                        entry,
                                    }
                                or {
                                    entry,
                                    config[entry],
                                }

                            return httpService4:JSONEncode(s)
