                    local function s(T, W)
                        local success, t = pcall(function()
                            return httpService4:JSONDecode(T)
                        end)
                        if not success or type(t) ~= "table" then
                            return false
                        end
                        success = {}
                        for index, entry in ipairs(b) do
                            success[entry] = true
                        end
                        for index2, entry2 in ipairs(t) do
                            if type(entry2) == "table" and success[entry2[1]] then
                                config[entry2[1]] = entry2[2]
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(contextSaveConfig)
                        contextRefreshAll()
                        if not W then
                            bG.check()
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                    local function n()
                        local success, B = pcall(function()
                            return isfile("HarvardLabs/configs/bestgear_shared.json")
                                    and readfile("HarvardLabs/configs/bestgear_shared.json")
                                or nil
                        end)
                        return success and B or nil
                    end
                    local b, B
                    N = n()
                    e = N and s(N, true)
                    if e then
                        b = N
                    else
                        G = z()
                        if G then
                            pcall(writefile, "HarvardLabs/configs/bestgear_shared.json", G)
                            b = G
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    B = z()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while not runtimeState.destroyed do
                            task.wait(1)
                            pcall(function()
                                local e = n()
                                local n = e and e ~= b
                                if n then
                                    b = e
                                    s(e)
                                    B = z()
                                    return
                                end
                                e = z()
                                n = e and e ~= B
                                if n then
                                    B = e
                                    pcall(writefile, "HarvardLabs/configs/bestgear_shared.json", e)

                local function QF(name)
                    local OF = e(true)
                    if partyQueue.entry(name, OF) then
                        return false, "is already in this party"
                    end
                    local SF, accounts = partyQueue.partyOf(name)
                    if SF and SF ~= OF then
                        return false, ("is in Party %d - take it off there first"):format(accounts or 0)
                    end
                    accounts, SF = OF.accounts, OF.accounts
                    local PF, _F = #SF + 1, {
                        name = name,
                    }
                    _F.role, _F.enabled, accounts[PF] = K(OF) and "leech" or "leader", true, _F
                    return true
                end

                    local LF = tostring(W.box.Text or z or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                    if LF == "" then
                        dF("Type a username first.")
                        return
                    end
                    if not LF:match("^[%w_]+$") or #LF < 3 or #LF > 20 then
                        dF("That is not a Roblox username - 3 to 20 letters, numbers or _.")
                        return
                    end
                    local OF, SF = QF(LF)
                    if not OF then
                        dF(LF .. " " .. tostring(SF) .. ".")
                        return
                    end
                    partyQueue.save()
                    z, W.box.Text = "", ""
                    dF("")
                    G()
                end

                        end
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        for index, entry in ipairs(listfiles("HarvardLabs/configs")) do
                            index = tostring(entry):match("release_(%d+)%.json$")
                            if index then
                                F(index, "<user id>")
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                for index3, entry3 in ipairs(type(config.modWhitelist) == "table" and config.modWhitelist or {}) do
                    F(entry3, i)
                end
                for entry4 in tostring(config.whPingId or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
                    F(entry4, "<discord id>")
                end
                if type(config.webhookUser) == "string" and config.webhookUser ~= "Harvard Labs" then
                    F(config.webhookUser, "<webhook name>")
                end
                if type(config.streamerNameText) == "string" and config.streamerNameText ~= "harvard student" then
                    F(config.streamerNameText, "<streamer name>")
                end
                for index4, entry5 in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                    b(entry5)
                end
                for index5, entry6 in ipairs(g) do
                    b(entry6)
                end
            end
            local function F(C)
                C = tostring(C)
                local g = I
                if g then
                    table.sort(k, function(i, G)
                        return #i > #G
                    end)
                    I = false
                end
                local I, i = C:lower(), k
                for index, entry in ipairs(i) do
                    index = I:find(entry, 1, true)
                    if index then
                        local i, G = {}, 1
                        while true do
                            local T, W = I:find(entry, G, true)
                            if not T then
                                break
                            end
                            g = I:sub(T - 1, T - 1):match("%w") or I:sub(W + 1, W + 1):match("%w")
                            if g then
                                i[#i + 1] = C:sub(G, W)
                            else
                                i[#i + 1] = C:sub(G, T - 1) .. o[entry]
                            end
                            G = W + 1
                        end
                        i[#i + 1] = C:sub(G)
                        C = table.concat(i)
                        I = (C:lower())
                    else
                    end
                end
                return (
                    C:gsub("([Uu][Ss][Ee][Rr][Ss][\\/]+)[^\\/%s\"']+", "%1<user>")
                        :gsub("(/home/)[^/%s\"']+", "%1<user>")
                        :gsub("[Dd]iscord%a*%.com/api/webhooks/%S+", "<webhook>")
                        :gsub("(Players[%.:]+)([%a_][%w_]*)", function(I, C)
                            if
                                C == "LocalPlayer"
                                or C == "PlayerAdded"
                                or C == "PlayerRemoving"
                                or C == "GetPlayers"
                                or C == "GetPlayerFromCharacter"
                            then
                                return nil
                            end
                            return I .. "<player>"
                        end)
                )
            end
            local function hide(C)
                local success, i = pcall(F, C)
                return success and i or "<line left out: it could not be checked for names>"
            end
            bug.hide = hide
            local function F(C, g)
                C, g = tostring(C):gsub("%c", " "), g or 900
                return if #C > g then C:sub(1, g) .. " ..." else C
            end
            local function C(g)
                local i = typeof(g)
                if i == "Color3" then
                    return "#" .. g:ToHex()
                end
                if i == "table" then
                    local success, G = pcall(httpService5.JSONEncode, httpService5, g)
                    return success and G or "<table>"
                end
                return tostring(g)
            end
            local function add(i, G)
                if not bug.on then
                    return
                end
                local s = ("[%s +%7.1fs] %-8s "):format(os.date("%H:%M:%S"), os.clock() - bug.t0, i)
                G = tostring(G):sub(1, 2000)
                bug.buf[#bug.buf + 1] = {
                    s,
                    G,
                }
                bug.bytes = bug.bytes + #s + math.min(#G, 904) + 1
                bug.n = bug.n + 1
            end
            bug.add = add

                    end)
                end
                bug.all = bug.all or {}

                i()
            end

                bug.t0 = os.clock()
                success, B = pcall(T)
                B = if not success then "Harvard Labs bug report\10header failed: " .. tostring(B) .. "\10" else B
                if not pcall(writefile, bug.file, B) then
                    C("Can't record a bug report.", "Could not write " .. bug.file .. ".", 8)
                    return
                end
                if not w then
                    bug.all = {
                        B,
                    }
                end
                bug.bytes = #B
                bug.on = true
                n(s)
                function runtimeState.bugLog(y, n)
                    add("LOG", ("[%s] %s"):format(tostring(y), tostring(n)))
                end
                function runtimeState.bugKey(y, n)
                    add(
                        "KEY",
                        (typeof(y) == "EnumItem" and y.Name or tostring(y))
                            .. (n and " - held back: a kit swap is due" or "")
                    )
                end
                B = bug.conns
                B[#B + 1] = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(gap)
                    bug.frames = bug.frames + 1
                    if gap > (bug.gap or 0) then
                        bug.gap = gap
                    end
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(y)
                    add("SPAWN", "new character")
                    task.spawn(p, y)
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(y)
                    pcall(b, y)
                    add("PLAYER", "joined: " .. tostring(y.Name))
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(y)
                    pcall(b, y)
                    add("PLAYER", "left: " .. tostring(y.Name))
                end)
                local y, n, o = 0, 0
                B[#B + 1] = logService.MessageOut:Connect(function(q, k)
                    local x = os.clock()
                    local a = x - y >= 1
                    if a then
                        y, n = x, 0
                    end
                    n += 1
                    x = n > 40 or q == o
                    if x then
                        return
                    end
                    o = q
                    add("CONSOLE", tostring(k and k.Name or "?"):gsub("^Message", "") .. ": " .. tostring(q))
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = guiService.ErrorMessageChanged:Connect(function(y)
                    if y and y ~= "" then
                        add("KICK", y)
                        G()
                    end
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(y, q)
                    add("TELEPORT", ("%s, place %s"):format(tostring(y and y.Name), tostring(q)))
                    if y == Enum.TeleportState.Started or y == Enum.TeleportState.RequestedFromServer then
                        contextBugStop("switched servers")
                    end
                end)
                task.spawn(p, localPlayer.Character)
                i()
                if s.part == 1 then
                    C(
                        "Now recording bug report, click to stop.",
                        ("Saving to %s in your executor's workspace folder, a new file every time you change server. It keeps recording until you press the bug again."):format(
                            bug.where
                        ),
                        10
                    )
                else
                    C(
                        ("Still recording the bug report (part %d)."):format(s.part),
                        ("A new file for this server in %s. Press the bug to stop recording."):format(bug.where),
                        8
                    )
                end
                context.log("Bug report", "recording to " .. bug.file)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local now, q, now2, p = os.clock(), -math.huge, (os.clock()), false
                    while bug.on and not runtimeState.destroyed do
                        local now3 = os.clock()
                        bug.fps = math.floor(bug.frames / math.max(now3 - now, 0.05) + 0.5)
                        bug.frames = 0
                        local success3, k = pcall(W)
                        add("TICK", success3 and k or "could not read: " .. tostring(k))
                        if now3 - q >= 2 then
                            pcall(K)
                            q = now3
                        else
                        end
                        if now3 - now2 >= 1 then
                            G()
                            now2 = now3
                        else
                        end
                        p = not p
                        rec.BackgroundTransparency = p and 0 or 0.6
                        if bug.bytes >= (w and 16 or 3) * 1024 * 1024 then
                            contextBugStop("the file reached its size limit")
                            task.defer(start2, true)
                            now = now3
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        now = now3
                    end
                end)
            end
            bug.start = start2
            local function y()
                if bug.on then
                    contextBugStop("stopped by hand")
                else
                    start2()
                end
            end
            bugButton.Activated:Connect(y)
            if v() then
                task.delay(3, function()
                    if not runtimeState.destroyed and not bug.on then
                        start2(true)
                    end
                end)
            end
            do
                local connection5
                local function q(E)
                    if runtimeState.destroyed then
                        connection5:Disconnect()
                        return
                    end
                    if E == Enum.TeleportState.Failed and not bug.on and v() then
                        task.delay(1, start2, true)
                    end
                end
                connection5 = localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(q)
            end
            local function y()
                if bug.on then
                    contextBugStop("stopped by hand")
                else
                    bugToast.Visible = false
                end
            end
            bugToast.Activated:Connect(y)
        end
        do
            local httpService6 = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local mD = {
                hold = nil,
                halted = false,
                tries = 0,
                lastTry = -math.huge,
            }
            context.MD = mD
            mD.canFiles = type(writefile) == "function"
                and type(readfile) == "function"
                and type(isfile) == "function"
            mD.file = function()
                return (context.PATH and context.PATH.data or "HarvardLabs/data")
                    .. "/modhold_"
                    .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                    .. ".json"
            end
            mD.pendFile = function()
                return (context.PATH and context.PATH.data or "HarvardLabs/data")
                    .. "/modpending_"
                    .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                    .. ".json"
            end
            mD.savePending = function(q)
                if not mD.canFiles then
                    return
                end
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(function()
                    writefile(mD.pendFile(), q and httpService6:JSONEncode(q) or "{}")
                end)
            end
            mD.save = function()
                if not mD.canFiles then
                    return
                end
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(function()
                    if mD.hold then
                        writefile(mD.file(), httpService6:JSONEncode(mD.hold))
                    elseif isfile(mD.file()) or mD.restEndedAt then
                        writefile(
                            mD.file(),
                            httpService6:JSONEncode({
                                holdUntil = 0,
                                restEndedAt = mD.restEndedAt,
                            })
                        )
                    end
                end)
            end
            mD.norm = function(q)
                return tostring(q or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("^@", ""):lower()
            end
            mD.names = function()
                local q = {}
                for index, entry in ipairs(type(config.modWhitelist) == "table" and config.modWhitelist or {}) do
                    index = mD.norm(entry)
                    if index ~= "" then
                        q[index] = true
                    end
                end
                return q
            end
            mD.partyIds = function()
                if mD.partyAt and os.clock() - mD.partyAt < 30 then
                    return mD.party
                end
                mD.partyAt = os.clock()
                local party
                local function E()
                    local p = game:GetService("TeleportService"):GetLocalPlayerTeleportData()
                    local J = type(p) == "table" and type(p.playerIds) == "table"
                    if J then
                        party = {}
                        local J, w = pairs, p.playerIds
                        for key, entry in J(w) do
                            key = tonumber(entry)
                            if key then
                                party[key] = true
                            end
                        end
                        w = tonumber(p.ownerId)
                        if w then
                            J = party
                            J[tonumber(p.ownerId)] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(E)
                mD.party = party
                return party
            end
            mD.logWhy = function(q)
                mD.why = q.text
                pcall(function()
                    q.at, q.job, q.who = os.time(), string.sub(game.JobId, 1, 8), localPlayer.Name
                    local E = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                    q.dungeon = E and tostring(E.Value) or ""
                    E = httpService6:JSONEncode(q) .. "\10"
                    if config.devLogs ~= true then
                        return
                    end
                    local q = type(appendfile) == "function"
                    if q then
                        appendfile("HarvardLabs/logs/moddetect.jsonl", E)
                    else
                        local q = ""
                        pcall(function()
                            q = readfile("HarvardLabs/logs/moddetect.jsonl")
                        end)
                        writefile("HarvardLabs/logs/moddetect.jsonl", q .. E)
                    end
                end)
            end
            mD.allowed = function(player, E)
                if player == localPlayer then
                    return true
                end
                if (E or mD.names())[mD.norm(player.Name)] == true then
                    return true
                end
                E = mD.inDungeon() and mD.partyIds() or nil
                if E and E[player.UserId] then
                    return true
                end
                mD.ours = mD.ours or {}
                local p, now = mD.norm(player.Name), os.clock()
                E = mD.ours[p]
                if not E or now - E.at > 10 then
                    E = {
                        at = now,
                        ours = context.AF
                                and context.AF.entry
                                and context.AF.entry(player.Name) ~= nil
                            or context.AF and context.AF.partyOf and context.AF.partyOf(player.Name) ~= nil
                            or context.AF and context.AF.presence and context.AF.presence(
                                player.Name,
                                config.afOnlineAge or 60
                            ) ~= nil
                            or false,
                    }
                    mD.ours[p] = E
                else
                end
                return E.ours
            end
            mD.LEVEL_IDS = {
                [85776757589518] = true,
                [115445507767090] = true,
            }
            mD.inDungeon = function()
                if mD.LEVEL_IDS[game.PlaceId] then

                if q == "Lobby" or game.PlaceId == 77649408247578 then

            end
            mD.queueText = function()
                local q, autoQueueDifficulty, p =
                    config.autoQueueMap, config.autoQueueDifficulty, config.autoQueueHardcore == true

                    q, autoQueueDifficulty, p = context.queuePick()
                else
                end
                local J, w = tostring(q or "?"), tostring(autoQueueDifficulty or "?")
                return ("%s, %s%s"):format(J, w, p and " (Hardcore)" or "")
            end
            mD.left = function()
                return mD.hold and math.max(0, (tonumber(mD.hold.holdUntil) or 0) - os.time()) or 0
            end
            mD.restingUntil = function()

                    or mD.hold.reason ~= "drop"
                    or mD.left() <= 0

                    return nil
                end
                return tonumber(mD.hold.holdUntil)
            end
            mD.fmt = function(q)
                local E = math.floor(q / 60)
                return ("%dm %02ds"):format(E, q % 60)
            end
            mD.stopAll = function()
                runtimeState.modHalt = true
                runtimeState.farmEnabled = false
                pcall(context.setLoopButtonState)

                        q:Move(Vector3.zero)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(contextClearDrawing)

            mD.goLobby = function()
                mD.tries, mD.lastTry = mD.tries + 1, os.clock()
                local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
                local V = remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("ReturnToLobbyEvent"))
                if V and mD.tries <= 2 then
                    pcall(V.FireServer, V)
                    context.log("ModDetect", "ReturnToLobbyEvent sent (try " .. mD.tries .. ")")
                    return
                end
                local q = 77649408247578
                pcall(function()
                    local V = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Utility.PlaceManager)
                    q = V.GetLivePlaceIdByName("Lobby") or q
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(q, localPlayer)
                end)
                context.log("ModDetect", "teleport to the lobby place sent (try " .. mD.tries .. ")")
            end
            mD.noteKick = function(q)
                if not mD.canFiles then
                    return
                end
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(function()
                    local V, paths = writefile, context.PATH
                    local p, toString, userId =
                        paths and context.PATH.data or "HarvardLabs/data", tostring, localPlayer.UserId
                    local E, Y =
                        p .. "/modkick_" .. toString(userId) .. ".json", {
                            at = os.time(),

                            name = localPlayer.Name,
                            why = tostring(q),
                        }
                    Y.job = string.sub(game.JobId, 1, 8)
                    V(E, httpService6:JSONEncode(Y))
                end)

            mD.kick = function(q)

                end)
            end
            mD.clear = function()

                mD.save()

                end

            mD.restRejoinOk = function()
                return mD.restEndedAt ~= nil

            end
            mD.toRest = function()
                if not (mD.hold and mD.hold.reason == "user") then
                    return
                end
                if mD.inDungeon() and mD.hold.job == game.JobId then
                    return
                end
                mD.hold.reason, mD.hold.stranger = "drop", true
                mD.hold.holdUntil = tonumber(mD.hold.restUntil)
                    or (tonumber(mD.hold.at) or os.time())
                        + (tonumber(config.modStrangerRest) or 7200)
                mD.save()
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    ("a stranger was in the last run - resting until %s before queueing again"):format(
                        os.date("%H:%M", mD.hold.holdUntil)
                    )
                )
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "warning",
                        "Resting",
                        ("A stranger was in the last run - resting until %s."):format(
                            os.date("%H:%M", mD.hold.holdUntil)
                        ),
                        8
                    )
                end
            end
            mD.lobbyHold = function()
                if not mD.hold then
                    return false
                end
                mD.toRest()
                if config.modDetect ~= true and not mD.hold.stranger and not mD.hold.farmBreak then
                    mD.clear()
                    return false
                end
                local q = mD.left()
                if q <= 0 then
                    if mD.hold.farmBreak then
                        mD.breakOver()
                        return false
                    end
                    mD.restEndedAt = os.time()
                    mD.clear()
                    context.log(
                        "ModDetect",
                        "the wait is over - back to the party (joining its run if it is in one)"
                    )
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "info",
                            "Back to the party",
                            "The wait after the mod detection is over - rejoining the party."
                        )
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local V, E =
                    mD.hold.farmBreak and "on a break; requeueing in %s"
                        or "mod detection flagged; requeueing in %s",
                    vmHelpers[127](mD.fmt(q))
                return true, V:format(vmHelpers:jB(E))
            end
            mD.flagFile = function()
                return (context.PATH and context.PATH.data or "HarvardLabs/data") .. "/modflag.json"
            end
            mD.readFlag = function()
                if not mD.canFiles then
                    return nil
                end
                local success, V = pcall(function()
                    local E = vmHelpers[127](readfile(mD.flagFile()))
                    return httpService6:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(E))
                end)
                return success and type(V) == "table" and V or nil
            end
            mD.still = function(q, V, how, p)
                mD.halted = true
                mD.stopAll()
                if config.modKick == true or p == true then
                    local now = os.clock()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while true do
                            local w, toNumber = os.clock() - now, tonumber
                            if not (w < (toNumber(config.modKickMaxWait) or 4)) then
                                break
                            end
                            if V and (mD.post == nil or mD.post.over) and os.clock() - now > 0.3 then
                                break
                            end
                            if not V then
                                break
                            end
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                        mD.kick(
                            ("a player not on the whitelist %s the run (%s)"):format(
                                tostring(how or "joined"),
                                tostring(q)
                            )
                        )
                    end)
                end
                if config.modStillReset ~= false and mD.resetJob ~= game.JobId then
                    mD.resetJob = game.JobId
                    local character = localPlayer.Character
                    local humanoid = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        runtimeState.selfResetAt = os.clock()
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid.Health = 0
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
                        end)
                        context.log("ModDetect", "reset the character - standing still at the spawn")
                    end
                end
                local dungeonName = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                mD.hold = {
                    holdUntil = os.time() + math.floor((tonumber(config.modStillMax) or 30) * 60),
                    at = os.time(),
                    who = tostring(q or "?"),
                    reason = "user",
                    kick = config.modKick == true or p == true or nil,
                    restUntil = os.time() + (tonumber(config.modStrangerRest) or 7200),
                    job = game.JobId,
                    dungeon = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or "",
                    queue = mD.queueText(),
                }
                mD.save()
                if context.WH then
                    context.WH.run = nil
                end
                if V then
                    pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                    pcall(function()
                        writefile(
                            mD.flagFile(),
                            httpService6:JSONEncode({
                                job = game.JobId,
                                at = os.time(),
                                by = localPlayer.Name,
                                who = tostring(q or "?"),
                                how = how,
                                kick = config.modKick == true or p == true or nil,
                            })
                        )
                    end)
                    mD.post = context.WH
                            and context.WH.modDetected
                            and context.WH.modDetected(tostring(q), mD.hold.queue, nil, how)
                        or nil
                    mD.postAt = os.clock()
                    context.log(
                        "ModDetect",
                        "flagged - every account here stands still until the run ends, then back to the lobby"
                    )
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "warning",
                            "Mod in the run",
                            "A stranger joined. Every account stands still until the run ends.",
                            8
                        )
                    end
                else
                    context.log("ModDetect", "another account here flagged - standing still until the run ends")
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "warning",
                            "Mod in the run",
                            "Another account flagged it. Standing still until the run ends.",
                            8
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            mD.allowedName = function(q, V)
                local E = mD.norm(q)
                if E == "" or E == mD.norm(localPlayer.Name) then
                    return true
                end
                if mD.names()[E] == true then
                    return true
                end
                E = mD.inDungeon() and mD.partyIds() or nil
                if E and V and E[V] then
                    return true
                end
                if context.AF and context.AF.entry and context.AF.entry(q) ~= nil then
                    return true
                end
                if context.AF and context.AF.partyOf and context.AF.partyOf(q) ~= nil then
                    return true
                end
                if context.AF and context.AF.presence and context.AF.presence(q, 86400) ~= nil then
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            mD.onJoinRequest = function(q, player, userId, p)
                if userId == "close" or type(player) ~= "string" or q == nil then
                    return
                end
                if
                    config.modDetect ~= true
                    or config.modJoinRequests == false
                    or mD.halted
                    or runtimeState.destroyed
                    or not mD.inDungeon()
                then
                    return
                end
                userId = tonumber(tostring(q):match("^(%d+)_"))
                if mD.allowedName(player, userId) then
                    return
                end
                mD.logWhy({
                    reason = "join request",
                    player = player,
                    userId = userId,
                    level = tostring(p),
                    text = ("%s asked to join the run and is not in the party or on the whitelist"):format(
                        player
                    ),
                })
                mD.still(player, true, "asked to join")
            end
            mD.hookJoins = function()
                if mD.joinsHookedJob == game.JobId then
                    return
                end
                local q = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
                local V = q and (q:FindFirstChild("showJoinRequest"))
                if not V then
                    return
                end
                mD.joinsHookedJob = game.JobId
                q = context.sliderConnections or {}
                q[#q + 1] = V.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(V, E, p, J)
                    local success, Y = pcall(mD.onJoinRequest, V, E, p, J)
                    if not success and context.log then
                        context.log("ModDetect", "join request check failed: " .. tostring(Y))
                    end
                end)
                q[#q + 1] = players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(q)
                    pcall(mD.detect, q)
                end)
            end
            mD.lateJoinGuard = function()
                if config.lateJoinGuard == false or not mD.inDungeon() then
                    return
                end
                if not (context.AF and context.AF.ownRun and context.AF.ownRun()) then
                    return
                end
                if context.AF.lateJoinWanted == game.JobId then
                    return
                end
                local q, V = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("dataLoaded"), localPlayer:FindFirstChild("lateJoin")
                local E = q ~= nil and q:IsA("BoolValue") and V ~= nil and V:IsA("StringValue")
                if E then
                    if q.Value ~= true then
                        return
                    end
                    if V.Value == "off" then
                        if mD.ljClosedJob ~= game.JobId then
                            mD.ljClosedJob, context.AF.ljOpen = game.JobId, nil
                        end
                        if mD.ljTryJob == game.JobId then
                            mD.ljTries = 0
                        end
                        return
                    end
                else
                    if mD.ljWaitJob ~= game.JobId then
                        mD.ljWaitJob, mD.ljWaitAt = game.JobId, os.clock()
                    end
                    if os.clock() - mD.ljWaitAt < (config.ljValueWait or 30) then
                        return
                    end
                    if mD.ljClosedJob == game.JobId and context.AF.ljOpen ~= game.JobId then
                        return
                    end
                end
                if mD.ljTryJob ~= game.JobId then
                    mD.ljTryJob = game.JobId
                    mD.ljTries = 0
                    mD.ljTryAt = nil
                end
                if mD.ljTries >= (config.ljTriesMax or 10) then
                    return
                end
                if os.clock() - (mD.ljTryAt or -math.huge) < (config.ljRetry or 3) then
                    return
                end
                q = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
                V = q and (q:FindFirstChild("hostSetLateJoin"))
                if not V then
                    return
                end
                mD.ljTryAt, mD.ljTries = os.clock(), mD.ljTries + 1
                if not E then
                    mD.ljClosedJob, context.AF.ljOpen = game.JobId, nil
                end
                pcall(V.FireServer, V, "off")
                if mD.ljTries == 1 then
                    context.log(
                        "ModDetect",
                        "late join closed for this run (opened only while an account of ours is out of it)"
                    )
                elseif mD.ljTries >= (config.ljTriesMax or 10) then
                    context.log(
                        "ModDetect",
                        ("late join would not close after %d tries - left as it is"):format(mD.ljTries)
                    )
                end
            end
            mD.detect = function(player)
                if mD.halted or config.modDetect ~= true or runtimeState.destroyed then
                    return
                end
                if player.Parent ~= players or mD.allowed(player) or not mD.inDungeon() then
                    return
                end
                local V = mD.partyIds()
                mD.logWhy({
                    reason = "player",
                    player = player.Name,
                    userId = player.UserId,
                    inParty = V ~= nil and V[player.UserId] == true,
                    partyKnown = V ~= nil,
                    text = player.Name .. " is not in the party or on the whitelist",
                })
                mD.still(player.Name, true)
            end
            mD.RANK = {
                common = 0.1,
                uncommon = 0.2,
                rare = 0.5,
                epic = 1,
                legendary = 2,
                ultimate = 3,
            }
            mD.bigDrop = function(q, V)
                local E, p = tostring(V or ""):lower(), tostring(q or ""):lower()
                V = p:find("valhalla mage", 1, true) ~= nil or p:find("valhalla warrior", 1, true) ~= nil
                if E == "ultimate" and config.modLeaveUltimate ~= false then
                    return true
                end
                if E == "legendary" and config.modLeaveLegendary ~= false then
                    return true
                end
                if
                    V
                    and config.modLeaveValT3 ~= false
                    and (E == "epic" or E == "legendary" or E == "ultimate")
                then
                    return true
                end
                if E == "epic" and config.modLeaveEpic == true then
                    return true
                end
                if config.modLeaveValAny == true and p:find("valhalla", 1, true) ~= nil then
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            mD.restSecs = function()
                local q = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(config.modWaitMin) or 10), 1, 60)
                local V = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(config.modWaitMax) or 30), q, 60)
                return math.random(q * 60, V * 60)
            end
            mD.dropWait = function()
                local q = config.whMerge ~= false and (tonumber(config.whMergeWait) or 12) or 0
                return math.max(
                    (tonumber(config.whLootWait) or 3) + (tonumber(config.whGatherFor) or 3),
                    tonumber(config.whRodinGather) or 4
                ) + q + 4
            end
            mD.dropRest = function(name, rarity)
                if mD.halted or config.modDetect ~= true or runtimeState.destroyed or not mD.inDungeon() then
                    return
                end
                local dungeonName = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                if not (dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) == "Northern Lands") then
                    return
                end
                local logWhy, p =
                    mD.logWhy, {
                        reason = "drop",
                        item = tostring(name),
                        rarity = tostring(rarity),
                    }
                p.text = ("%s (%s) dropped"):format(tostring(name), tostring(rarity))
                logWhy(p)
                if mD.pendingDrop then
                    return
                end
                mD.pendingDrop = {
                    name = name,
                    rarity = rarity,
                    at = os.clock(),
                }
                mD.savePending({
                    name = tostring(name),
                    rarity = tostring(rarity),
                    job = game.JobId,
                    at = os.time(),
                })
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    ("%s (%s) dropped - finishing the run (the bonus boss too), then the lobby and a rest"):format(
                        tostring(name),
                        tostring(rarity)
                    )
                )
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        tostring(rarity):lower() == "ultimate" and "dropUltimate" or "drop",
                        "Leaving after this run",
                        ("%s (%s) - then a rest before the next queue."):format(tostring(name), tostring(rarity)),
                        8
                    )
                end
            end
            mD.finishDrop = function()
                local pendingDrop = mD.pendingDrop
                if not pendingDrop or mD.halted then
                    return
                end
                local name, rarity = pendingDrop.name, pendingDrop.rarity
                mD.pendingDrop = nil
                mD.savePending(nil)
                if mD.inDungeon() then
                    mD.halted = true
                    mD.stopAll()
                end
                local q, who, dungeonName =
                    mD.restSecs(),
                    ("%s (%s)"):format(tostring(name or "?"), tostring(rarity or "?")),
                    contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                mD.hold = {
                    holdUntil = os.time() + q,
                    at = os.time(),
                    who = who,
                    reason = "drop",
                    job = game.JobId,
                    dungeon = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or "",
                    queue = mD.queueText(),
                }
                mD.save()
                pcall(function()
                    local J = "HarvardLabs/data/af_" .. string.lower(localPlayer.Name) .. ".json"
                    local w = httpService6:JSONDecode(readfile(J))
                    if type(w) == "table" then
                        w.resting, w.dropPending, w.at = mD.hold.holdUntil, nil, os.time()
                        writefile(J, httpService6:JSONEncode(w))
                    end
                end)
                mD.post = context.WH
                        and context.WH.dropRest
                        and context.WH.dropRest(name, rarity, mD.hold.queue, mD.hold.holdUntil)
                    or nil
                mD.postAt = os.clock()
                mD.goAt = os.clock() + (config.modFinishWait or 3)
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    ("run over after the %s drop - to the lobby, requeueing in %s"):format(who, mD.fmt(q))
                )
            end
            mD.BREAK_KEYS = { "breakOn", "breakFarmMin", "breakFarmMax", "breakRestMin", "breakRestMax" }
            mD.testSeen = os.time()
            mD.bParty = function()
                local q
                pcall(function()
                    if context.AF and context.AF.load then
                        context.AF.load()
                    end
                    local V = context.AF and context.AF.partyOf
                    if V then
                        q = context.AF.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, context.AF.doc)
                    end
                end)
                local V = type(q) == "table" and type(q.id) == "string" and q.id ~= ""
                if V then
                    return q
                end
                return nil
            end
            mD.bget = function(q)
                if mD.bPend and mD.bPend[q] ~= nil then
                    return mD.bPend[q]
                end
                local V = mD.bParty()
                if V then
                    if V.breakOn == nil and config.breakOn == true and not mD.bMigrated then
                        mD.bMigrated = true
                        local E = {}
                        for index, key in ipairs(mD.BREAK_KEYS) do
                            E[key] = config[key]
                        end
                        mD.bset(E)
                        if mD.bPend and mD.bPend[q] ~= nil then
                            return mD.bPend[q]
                        end
                    end
                    if V[q] ~= nil then
                        return V[q]
                    end
                    if q == "breakOn" then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return config[q]
            end
            mD.bOn = function()
                return mD.bget("breakOn") == true
            end
            mD.bset = function(q)
                mD.bPend = mD.bPend or {}
                for key, entry in pairs(q) do
                    config[key] = entry
                    mD.bPend[key] = entry
                end
                pcall(Z)
                if mD.bFlushing then
                    return
                end
                mD.bFlushing = true
                task.delay(0.5, function()
                    mD.bFlushing = false
                    local bPend = mD.bPend
                    mD.bPend = nil
                    if not bPend then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        if
                            not (context.AF and context.AF.loadReal and context.AF.partyOf and context.AF.save)
                        then
                            return
                        end
                        context.AF.loadReal(true)
                        local V = context.AF.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, context.AF.doc)
                        if type(V) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end
                        for key2, entry2 in pairs(bPend) do
                            V[key2] = entry2
                        end
                        context.AF.save()
                    end)
                end)
            end
            mD.brkFile = function()
                local q, V = context.PATH and context.PATH.data or "HarvardLabs/data", mD.bParty()
                if V then
                    return q .. "/partybreak_" .. tostring(V.id) .. ".json", true
                end
                return q .. "/modbreak_" .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId) .. ".json", false
            end
            mD.brkRead = function(q)
                local brkF, E = mD.brkFile()
                local brkAt = os.clock()
                if q or not mD.brk or mD.brkF ~= brkF or brkAt - (mD.brkAt or -math.huge) >= 1 then
                    local q = mD.canFiles and context.readJson and context.readJson(brkF)
                    mD.brk = type(q) == "table" and q or {}
                    mD.brkF = brkF
                    mD.brkAt = brkAt
                end
                return mD.brk, E
            end
            mD.brkSave = function()
                if not (mD.canFiles and mD.brk and mD.brkF) then
                    return
                end
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(function()
                    writefile(mD.brkF, httpService6:JSONEncode(mD.brk))
                end)
                mD.brkAt = os.clock()
            end
            mD.rollFarm = function()
                if tonumber(config.breakFarmSecs) then
                    return math.floor(tonumber(config.breakFarmSecs))
                end
                local q = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mD.bget("breakFarmMin")) or 3), 1, 24)
                local V = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mD.bget("breakFarmMax")) or 5), q, 24)
                return math.random(q * 3600, V * 3600)
            end
            mD.rollRest = function()
                if tonumber(config.breakRestSecs) then
                    return math.floor(tonumber(config.breakRestSecs))
                end
                local q = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mD.bget("breakRestMin")) or 20), 1, 360)
                local V = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mD.bget("breakRestMax")) or 40), q, 360)
                return math.random(q * 60, V * 60)
            end
            mD.newPhase = function(q, start)
                local seen = os.time()
                q.n, q.start, q.len, q.restLen = (tonumber(q.n) or 0) + 1, start, mD.rollFarm(), mD.rollRest()
                q.restUntil = nil
                q.restAt = nil
                q.seen = seen
                mD.brkSave()
            end
            mD.brkState = function()
                local q, V = mD.brkRead()
                local seen, p = os.time(), q
                if V then
                    local V = tonumber(config.whSessionGap) or 21600
                    local J = tonumber(p.restUntil)
                    local function w()
                        return J and seen >= J
                            or not J
                                and (seen - (tonumber(q.seen) or 0) > V or not tonumber(q.start) or not tonumber(
                                    q.len
                                ))
                    end
                    if w() then
                        q = mD.brkRead(true)
                        J = tonumber(q.restUntil)
                        if w() then
                            local w = seen - (tonumber(q.seen) or 0) > V
                            if J and seen >= J then
                                mD.newPhase(q, w and seen or J)
                            else
                                mD.newPhase(
                                    q,
                                    math.min(
                                        math.floor(tonumber(context.WH and context.WH.sessionStart) or seen),
                                        seen
                                    )
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        if seen - (tonumber(p.seen) or 0) >= 60 then
                            q = mD.brkRead(true)
                            q.seen = seen
                            mD.brkSave()
                        else
                            q = p
                        end
                    end
                    return q
                end
                local q, start =
                    math.floor(tonumber(context.WH and context.WH.sessionStart) or seen), tonumber(p.restUntil)
                if start and seen >= start then
                    p.start, p.len = start, mD.rollFarm()
                    p.restUntil = nil
                    p.session = q
                    mD.brkSave()
                elseif
                    not start
                    and (tonumber(p.session) ~= q or not tonumber(p.start) or not tonumber(p.len))
                then
                    p.session, p.start, p.len = q, q, mD.rollFarm()
                    mD.brkSave()
                end
                return p
            end
            mD.hm = function(q)
                q = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(q) or 0))
                if q >= 3600 then
                    local V, E = math.floor(q / 3600), math.floor(q / 60) % 60
                    return ("%dh %02dm"):format(V, E)
                end
                local V = math.floor(q / 60)
                return ("%dm %02ds"):format(V, q % 60)
            end
            mD.onBreak = function()
                return mD.hold ~= nil and mD.hold.farmBreak == true
            end
            mD.breakAt = function()
                if not mD.onBreak() or mD.hold.test or mD.left() <= 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                return tonumber(mD.hold.at)
            end
            mD.breakPresence = function(resting, restBreak)
                pcall(function()
                    local E = "HarvardLabs/data/af_" .. string.lower(localPlayer.Name) .. ".json"
                    local p = httpService6:JSONDecode(readfile(E))
                    if type(p) == "table" then
                        p.resting, p.restBreak, p.dropPending, p.at = resting, restBreak, nil, os.time()
                        writefile(E, httpService6:JSONEncode(p))
                    end
                end)
            end
            mD.breakTick = function(q)
                local V, E = mD.brkRead()
                local holdUntil = os.time()
                if mD.onBreak() then
                    if E and not mD.hold.test then
                        local holdUntil2, w, Y =
                            tonumber(V.restUntil),
                            tonumber(mD.hold.holdUntil) or 0,
                            (tonumber(V.n) or 0) == (tonumber(mD.hold.bn) or -1)
                        if Y and holdUntil2 and holdUntil2 > holdUntil and math.abs(holdUntil2 - w) >= 2 then
                            mD.hold.holdUntil = holdUntil2
                            mD.save()
                            mD.breakPresence(holdUntil2, mD.breakAt())
                        elseif not Y and not holdUntil2 and w > holdUntil then
                            mD.hold.holdUntil = holdUntil
                            mD.save()
                        end
                    end
                    if mD.left() <= 0 and not mD.halted and q then
                        mD.breakOver()
                    end
                    return
                end
                local pendingBreak = mD.pendingBreak
                if pendingBreak and not pendingBreak.test and E then
                    local w = tonumber(V.restUntil)
                    if
                        not mD.bOn()
                        or (tonumber(V.n) or 0) ~= (tonumber(pendingBreak.bn) or -1)
                            and not (w and w > holdUntil)
                    then
                        mD.pendingBreak = nil
                        context.log("ModDetect", "the party's break was called off - farming on")
                        pendingBreak = nil
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if not pendingBreak and not mD.hold and not mD.pendingDrop then
                    local w = E and tonumber(V.testAt)
                    if w and w > (mD.testSeen or 0) and holdUntil - w < 600 then
                        mD.testSeen = w
                        mD.pendingBreak = {
                            at = os.clock(),
                            restSecs = tonumber(V.testSecs) or 30,
                            test = true,
                            testAt = w,
                        }
                        context.log(
                            "ModDetect",
                            ("test rest for the party (%ds) %s"):format(
                                mD.pendingBreak.restSecs,
                                q and "after this run" or "now"
                            )
                        )
                        if q and context.notify then
                            context.notify(
                                "info",
                                "Test rest after this run",
                                ("A %ds test rest for the party once this run is over."):format(
                                    mD.pendingBreak.restSecs
                                ),
                                8
                            )
                        end
                    elseif mD.bOn() then
                        local V = mD.brkState()
                        local w, joinUntil =
                            holdUntil - (tonumber(V.start) or holdUntil), E and tonumber(V.restUntil)
                        if joinUntil and joinUntil > holdUntil + 5 then
                            mD.pendingBreak = {
                                at = os.clock(),
                                bn = V.n,
                                joinUntil = joinUntil,
                            }
                            context.log(
                                "ModDetect",
                                ("the party is taking its break - resting with it until %s %s"):format(
                                    os.date("%H:%M:%S", joinUntil),
                                    q and "after this run" or "now"
                                )
                            )
                            if q and context.notify then
                                context.notify(
                                    "info",
                                    "Rest after this run",
                                    ("The party is taking its break - resting with it until %s once this run is over."):format(
                                        os.date("%H:%M", joinUntil)
                                    ),
                                    8
                                )
                            end
                        elseif w >= (tonumber(V.len) or math.huge) then
                            mD.pendingBreak = {
                                at = os.clock(),
                                bn = V.n,
                                restSecs = tonumber(V.restLen) or mD.rollRest(),
                            }
                            context.log(
                                "ModDetect",
                                ("%sfarmed %s - a %s rest after this run"):format(
                                    E and "the party " or "",
                                    mD.hm(w),
                                    mD.hm(mD.pendingBreak.restSecs)
                                )
                            )
                            if q and context.notify then
                                context.notify(
                                    "info",
                                    "Rest after this run",
                                    ("%s %s - a %s rest once this run is over."):format(
                                        E and "The party farmed" or "Farmed",
                                        mD.hm(w),
                                        mD.hm(mD.pendingBreak.restSecs)
                                    ),
                                    8
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pendingBreak = mD.pendingBreak
                if not pendingBreak then
                    return
                end
                if
                    not q
                    or context.runFailed ~= nil and context.runFailed() == true
                    or context.LB ~= nil and context.LB.runOverAt ~= nil
                    or os.clock() - (pendingBreak.at or 0)
                        > (tonumber(config.breakPendingMax) or 1800)
                then
                    mD.finishBreak()
                end
            end
            mD.finishBreak = function()
                local pendingBreak = mD.pendingBreak
                if not pendingBreak or mD.halted then
                    return
                end
                mD.pendingBreak = nil
                local restAt, E, p = os.time(), mD.brkRead(true)
                local J, w, Y = false, tonumber(E.start) or restAt
                if p then
                    if pendingBreak.test then
                        local v = tonumber(E.testUntil)
                        if tonumber(E.testFor) == tonumber(pendingBreak.testAt) and v and v > restAt then
                            Y, J = v, true
                        else
                            Y = restAt + (tonumber(pendingBreak.restSecs) or 30)
                            E.testUntil, E.testFor = Y, pendingBreak.testAt
                            mD.brkSave()
                        end
                    else
                        local v = tonumber(E.restUntil)
                        if v and v > restAt then
                            Y, J = v, true
                        else
                            Y = restAt + (tonumber(E.restLen) or tonumber(pendingBreak.restSecs) or mD.rollRest())
                            E.restUntil = Y
                            E.restAt = restAt
                            mD.brkSave()
                        end
                    end
                else
                    local v = mD.brkState()
                    w, Y =
                        tonumber(v.start) or restAt,
                        tonumber(pendingBreak.joinUntil)
                            or restAt + (tonumber(pendingBreak.restSecs) or mD.rollRest())
                    v.restUntil = Y
                    mD.brkSave()
                end
                local v, dungeonName = restAt - w, contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                mD.hold = {
                    holdUntil = Y,
                    at = restAt,
                    who = pendingBreak.test and "Test rest" or "Break",
                    reason = "drop",
                    farmBreak = true,
                    test = pendingBreak.test or nil,
                    job = game.JobId,
                    dungeon = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or "",
                    queue = mD.queueText(),
                    bn = p and not pendingBreak.test and E.n or nil,
                }
                mD.save()
                mD.breakPresence(Y, not pendingBreak.test and restAt or nil)
                mD.post = context.WH
                        and context.WH.breakRest
                        and context.WH.breakRest(v, Y, mD.hold.queue, pendingBreak.test == true, J)
                    or nil
                mD.postAt = os.clock()
                if mD.inDungeon() then
                    mD.halted = true
                    mD.stopAll()
                    mD.goAt = os.clock() + (config.modFinishWait or 3)
                end
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    ("%s - resting until %s, then back to the party"):format(
                        pendingBreak.test and "test rest" or "break",
                        os.date("%H:%M:%S", Y)
                    )
                )
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "info",
                        pendingBreak.test and "Test rest" or "Taking a break",
                        ("Resting until %s, then back to the party."):format(os.date("%H:%M:%S", Y)),
                        8
                    )
                end
            end
            mD.breakOver = function()
                mD.restEndedAt = os.time()
                mD.clear()
                mD.brkState()
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    "the break is over - back to the party (joining its run if it is in one)"
                )
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify("info", "Break over", "Back to farming - rejoining the party.")
                end
            end
            mD.endBreak = function(q)
                if not (mD.onBreak() or mD.pendingBreak ~= nil) then
                    return false
                end
                local V = mD.onBreak() and mD.hold.test == true
                    or mD.pendingBreak ~= nil and mD.pendingBreak.test == true
                mD.pendingBreak = nil
                if mD.onBreak() then
                    mD.restEndedAt = os.time()
                    mD.clear()
                    mD.breakPresence(nil, nil)
                    if mD.halted then
                        mD.halted = false
                        runtimeState.modHalt = false
                        if mD.inDungeon() then
                            runtimeState.farmEnabled = true
                        end
                        pcall(context.setLoopButtonState)
                    end
                    if context.LB and context.LB.place == "Lobby" and context.queueNow then
                        pcall(context.queueNow, "break ended")
                    end
                end
                local E, p = mD.brkRead(true)
                if p then
                    if not V then
                        mD.newPhase(E, os.time())
                    end
                else
                    E.start, E.len = os.time(), mD.rollFarm()
                    E.restUntil = nil
                    mD.brkSave()
                end
                E = mD.brkRead()
                context.log(
                    "ModDetect",
                    ("the %sbreak was ended (%s) - farming again, next rest in %s"):format(
                        p and "party's " or "",
                        tostring(q or "by hand"),
                        mD.hm(E.len)
                    )
                )
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "info",
                        "Break ended",
                        ("Farming again - the next rest in %s."):format(mD.hm(E.len))
                    )
                end
                return true
            end
            mD.applyPhase = function()
                local q, V = mD.brkRead(true)
                if mD.onBreak() then
                    local E = os.time() + mD.rollRest()
                    mD.hold.holdUntil = E
                    mD.save()
                    if V then
                        if not mD.hold.test then
                            q.restUntil = E
                            mD.brkSave()
                        end
                    else
                        mD.brkState().restUntil = E
                        mD.brkSave()
                    end
                    mD.breakPresence(E, mD.breakAt())
                    context.log("ModDetect", "rest restarted from the sliders - until " .. os.date("%H:%M:%S", E))
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "info",
                            "Rest restarted",
                            ("Resting until %s."):format(os.date("%H:%M:%S", E))
                        )
                    end
                    return
                end
                mD.pendingBreak = nil
                if V then
                    mD.newPhase(q, os.time())
                else
                    local q = mD.brkState()
                    q.start, q.len = os.time(), mD.rollFarm()
                    q.restUntil = nil
                    mD.brkSave()
                end
                V = mD.brkRead()
                context.log("ModDetect", "farm timer restarted from the sliders - next rest in " .. mD.hm(V.len))
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "info",
                        "Farm timer restarted",
                        ("The next rest in %s%s."):format(
                            mD.hm(V.len),
                            mD.bOn() and "" or " (Take breaks is off)"
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            mD.testRest = function()
                if mD.onBreak() or mD.halted then
                    return false
                end
                local q, V, E = math.floor(tonumber(config.breakTestSecs) or 30), mD.brkRead(true)
                local p = mD.inDungeon()
                if E then
                    V.testAt = os.time()
                    V.testSecs = q
                    V.testUntil = nil
                    V.testFor = nil
                    mD.brkSave()
                    context.log("ModDetect", ("test rest (%ds) for the whole party"):format(q))
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "info",
                            "Test rest for the party",
                            ("A %ds rest for every account of the party, each %s, then back to farming."):format(
                                q,
                                p and "once its run is over" or "at once in the lobby"
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    return true
                end
                mD.pendingBreak = {
                    at = os.clock(),
                    restSecs = q,
                    test = true,
                }
                context.log("ModDetect", ("test rest (%ds) %s"):format(q, p and "after this run" or "now"))
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "info",
                        p and "Test rest after this run" or "Test rest",
                        ("A %ds rest%s, then back to the party."):format(q, p and " once this run is over" or "")
                    )
                end
                return true
            end
            mD.breakText = function()
                if mD.onBreak() then
                    local q = mD.hold.test and "Test rest" or "Resting"
                    if mD.halted then
                        local V = vmHelpers[127](os.date("%H:%M:%S", mD.hold.holdUntil))
                        return ("%s - to the lobby, back at %s"):format(q, vmHelpers:jB(V))
                    end
                    local V, E = os.date("%H:%M:%S", mD.hold.holdUntil), vmHelpers[127](mD.hm(mD.left()))
                    return ("%s - back at %s (%s left)"):format(q, V, vmHelpers:jB(E))
                end
                local pendingBreak = mD.pendingBreak
                if pendingBreak then
                    if pendingBreak.joinUntil then
                        local V = vmHelpers[127](os.date("%H:%M", pendingBreak.joinUntil))
                        return ("Resting with the party after this run, until %s"):format(vmHelpers:jB(V))
                    end
                    local V, E =
                        pendingBreak.test and "Test rest" or "Rest", vmHelpers[127](mD.hm(pendingBreak.restSecs))
                    return ("%s after this run - %s"):format(V, vmHelpers:jB(E))
                end
                if not mD.bOn() then
                    return "Off - it farms without breaks"
                end
                local q, q = mD.brkRead()
                local V, E = mD.brkState(), q and "The party: farming" or "Farming"
                local q, p, J =
                    mD.hm(os.time() - (tonumber(V.start) or os.time())),
                    mD.hm(V.len),
                    vmHelpers[127](os.date("%H:%M", (tonumber(V.start) or os.time()) + (tonumber(V.len) or 0)))
                return ("%s %s of %s - rest at about %s"):format(E, q, p, vmHelpers:jB(J))
            end
            mD.onLoot = function(q)
                if type(q) ~= "table" or type(q.items) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                local iteratePairs, items, p, J, w = pairs, q.items, 0
                for key, item in iteratePairs(items) do
                    q = type(item) == "table" and item.template ~= nil
                    if q then
                        local q = item.itemName
                        key = q == nil
                        if key then
                            pcall(function()
                                q = item.template.Name
                            end)
                        end
                        local V = mD.bigDrop(q, item.rarity)
                        if V then
                            local V = mD.RANK[tostring(item.rarity):lower()] or 0
                            local E = V > p
                            if E then
                                J, w = item, q
                                p = V
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if J then
                    mD.dropRest(tostring(w), tostring(J.rarity):lower())
                end
            end
            mD.hookLoot = function()
                if mD.lootConn then
                    return
                end

                local V = remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("cloneRewardGui"))

                    return

                    pcall(mD.onLoot, q)

            end
            pcall(mD.hookLoot)

                        if Y.on and a.Enabled then

                        end

                        return false
                    end
                    local dF = K.ConnectedBoss
                    K = type(dF) == "table" and dF.boss or nil
                    if not (typeof(K) == "Instance" and K:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
                        return true

                    dF = K:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    return not (dF and dF.Health > 0)
                end)
                return success and e == true

            local function n(o)
                o = tonumber(o) or 0
                local k = math.abs(o)
                if k >= 1000000000000 then
                    return ("%.2fT"):format(o / 1000000000000)
                end
                if k >= 1000000000 then
                    return ("%.2fB"):format(o / 1000000000)
                end
                if k >= 1000000 then
                    return ("%.2fM"):format(o / 1000000)
                end
                if k >= 1000 then
                    return ("%.1fK"):format(o / 1000)
                end
                return tostring(math.floor(o))
            end
            local function o(k)
                k = math.max(math.floor(k), 0)
                local x = math.floor(k / 60)
                return ("%d:%02d"):format(x, k % 60)
            end
