            local function n(o)
                local x = v[o]
                x.n = x.n + 1
                o = x.items[x.n]
                if not o then
                    o = x.make()
                    x.items[x.n] = o
                else
                end
                return o
            end
            local function o()
                for key, entry in pairs(v) do
                    key = entry.items
                    for index = 1, #key, 1 do
                        local visible = index <= entry.n
                        if key[index].Visible ~= visible then
                            key[index].Visible = visible
                        end
                    end
                    entry.n = 0
                end
            end
            local x, e, N, K, dF = 0, 0, 0, 0, 1
            local function QF(OF, SF)
                local DF, _F, cF = x * 0.5 + (OF - N) * dF, e * 0.5, (SF - K) * dF
                return DF, _F + cF
            end
            local function OF(SF, DF, _F)
                local cF = SF + _F >= 0 and SF - _F <= x and DF + _F >= 0 and DF - _F <= e
                return cF
            end
            local function SF(DF, _F, cF, uF, mF, zIndex, thickness)
                local qF, VF = QF(DF, _F)
                if not OF(qF, VF, cF) then
                    return
                end
                DF = n("round")
                DF.Position, DF.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(qF, VF), UDim2.fromOffset(cF * 2, cF * 2)
                DF.ZIndex = zIndex
                zIndex = k[DF]
                if thickness then
                    DF.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    zIndex.Enabled = true
                    zIndex.Color = uF
                    zIndex.Thickness = thickness
                    zIndex.Transparency = mF
                else
                    DF.BackgroundColor3 = uF
                    DF.BackgroundTransparency = mF
                    if zIndex.Enabled then
                        zIndex.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
            end
            local function DF(_F, cF, uF, mF, RF, backgroundColor3, backgroundTransparency, zIndex)
                local EF, pF = QF(_F, cF)
                _F, cF = math.max(uF * 2 * dF, 1), math.max(mF * 2 * dF, 1)
                if not OF(EF, pF, math.max(_F, cF)) then
                    return
                end
                mF = n("rect")
                mF.Position, mF.Size, mF.Rotation =
                    UDim2.fromOffset(EF, pF), UDim2.fromOffset(_F, cF), math.deg(RF)
                mF.ZIndex = zIndex
                mF.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3
                mF.BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency
            end
            local function _F(cF, uF, text, textColor3, yF)
                local qF, VF = QF(cF, uF)
                if not OF(qF, VF, 80) then
                    return
                end
                uF = n("label")
                uF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(qF + yF + 4, VF)
                uF.Text = text
                uF.TextColor3 = textColor3
            end
            local red = theme2.Red
            local purple = theme2.Purple
            local white = theme2.White
            local blue = theme2.Blue
            local orb = theme2.Orb
            local color2 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 116, 132)
            local function VF()
                local EF = localPlayer.Character
                local pF = EF and (EF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                if pF then
                    zone.cx, zone.cy, zone.cz = pF.Position.X, pF.Position.Y, pF.Position.Z
                end
                if not zone.cx then
                    return false
                end
                EF, pF = view.AbsoluteSize, config.mapFollow == false
                if pF then
                    local pF, jF, UF = zone.anchor(), EF.X, EF.Y
                    local JF, wF = pF.x, pF.z
                    x, e, N, K = jF, UF, JF, wF
                else
                    local pF, jF, UF = zone.big and zone.freeAt or nil, EF.X, EF.Y
                    local JF, wF = pF and pF.x or zone.cx, pF and pF.z or zone.cz
                    x, e, N, K = jF, UF, JF, wF
                end
                EF = zone.big and (config.minimapBigRange or 160) or (config.minimapRange or 110)
                dF = math.min(x, e) * 0.5 / EF * (zone.big and zone.zoomB or zone.zoomS)
                EF = dF
                return EF > 0
            end
            local function EF(pF, jF, UF, JF)
                local transform, size, vF = pF.CFrame, pF.Size, pF:IsA("Part")
                local MF = vF and pF.Shape or nil
                local ZF = MF == Enum.PartType.Ball
                if ZF then
                    SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(size.X * 0.5 * dF, 2), jF, UF, JF)
                    return
                end
                local rightVector, upVector, lookVector, oF =
                    transform.RightVector, transform.UpVector, transform.LookVector, MF == Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                if oF then
                    ZF = math.abs(rightVector.Y) > 0.7
                    if ZF then
                        SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5 * dF, 2), jF, UF, JF)
                    else
                        DF(
                            transform.X,
                            transform.Z,
                            size.X * 0.5,
                            math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5,
                            math.atan2(rightVector.Z, rightVector.X),
                            jF,
                            UF,
                            JF
                        )
                    end
                    return
                end
                oF, MF, ZF = math.abs(rightVector.Y), math.abs(upVector.Y), math.abs(lookVector.Y)
                local rF, AF, kF
                if MF >= oF and MF >= ZF then
                    rF, AF, kF = rightVector, size.X * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                else
                    if oF >= ZF then
                        rF, AF, kF = upVector, size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                    else
                        rF, AF, kF = rightVector, size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5
                    end
                end
                MF = (not vF or pF:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil)
                    and AF > 1
                    and kF > 1
                    and math.abs(AF - kF) <= math.max(AF, kF) * 0.1
                if MF then
                    SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(AF, kF) * dF, jF, UF, JF)
                    return
                end
                DF(transform.X, transform.Z, AF, kF, math.atan2(rF.Z, rF.X), jF, UF, JF)
            end
            local function pF(jF, UF, JF, wF, YF, color, transparency, zIndex)
                local nF, fF = QF(jF, UF)
                jF = OF(nF, fF, JF * dF)
                if not jF then
                    return
                end
                jF, UF = math.max((JF - wF) * dF, 1), n("arc")
                UF.Position, UF.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nF, fF), UDim2.fromOffset(jF * 2, jF * 2)
                UF.ZIndex = zIndex
                zIndex = k[UF]
                zIndex.Color, zIndex.Thickness = color, math.max(wF * dF, 1)
                zIndex.Transparency = transparency
                L[UF].Rotation = math.deg(YF)
            end
            zone.clearMarks = function()
                for key, entry in pairs(v) do
                    entry.n = 0

                o()
            end

                local v, camera = 0, contextWorkspace.CurrentCamera

                    local absolutePosition, jF, now = view.AbsolutePosition, {}, os.clock()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.orbScan) do

                        entry = index and hazardReader.parts[index]
                        if index and index.Parent and entry and entry.spawn and not jF[index] then

                            if YF then
                                v += 1

                                if not hlFuse3D then
                                    hlFuse3D = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                                    hlFuse3D.Name = "HLFuse3D"
                                    hlFuse3D.BackgroundTransparency, hlFuse3D.AnchorPoint, hlFuse3D.Size =

                                    math.max((config.orbFuse or 20) - (now - entry.spawn), 0),
                                    string.lower(index.Name)
                                hlFuse3D.TextColor3 = vF:find("red", 1, true)
                                        and Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                                    or vF:find("green", 1, true) and Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 90)
                                    or vF:find("yellow", 1, true) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 60)
                                    or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                                hlFuse3D.Text = YF < 5 and ("%.1f"):format(YF) or ("%.0f"):format(YF)

                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end

                    if zone.fuse3[index2].Visible then
                        zone.fuse3[index2].Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
            local function L(v, k, jF, UF, backgroundColor3, wF, zIndex)
                local vF, MF = QF(v, k)
                if not OF(vF, MF, wF) then
                    return
                end
                k = n("bar")
                k.Position, k.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vF, MF + jF + 3), UDim2.fromOffset(wF, 3)
                k.ZIndex = zIndex
                v = a[k]
                v.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(UF, 0, 1), 1)
                v.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3
                v.ZIndex = zIndex
            end

            local function o(k, a, QF)
                local OF = L.orig[k]
                if not OF then
                    OF = {}
                    L.orig[k] = OF
                else
                end
                if OF[a] == nil then
                    local success, DF = pcall(function()
                        return k[a]
                    end)
                    if not success or DF == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    OF[a] = DF
                end
                pcall(function()
                    k[a] = QF
                end)
            end
            local function k(a)
                if a:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if a.Transparency >= 0.98 then
                        return
                    end
                    o(
                        a,
                        "Color",
                        typeof(config.map3DGrey) == "Color3" and config.map3DGrey or Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 122)
                    )
                    o(a, "Material", Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
                    if a:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        o(a, "TextureID", "")
                    end
                    if a:IsA("UnionOperation") then
                        o(a, "UsePartColor", true)
                    end
                elseif a:IsA("Decal") or a:IsA("Texture") then
                    o(a, "Transparency", 1)
                elseif a:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    o(a, "TextureId", "")
                elseif a:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    o(a, "Parent", nil)
                end
            end

                return false

            local see, setMetatable5, weakKeys6 = {}, setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",

            see.a = setMetatable5({}, weakKeys6)
            see.t = 0
            see.hit = nil
            see.ray = nil
            see.geo = function(M)
                if M:IsA("Terrain") or not (M.Anchored and M.CanCollide and M.Transparency < 0.95) then
                    return false
                end
                local n = M
                while n and n ~= contextWorkspace do
                    M = string.lower(n.Name)
                    if
                        M:find("hitbox", 1, true)
                        or M:find("precast", 1, true)
                        or M:find("telegraph", 1, true)
                        or M:find("warning", 1, true)
                        or M:find("safespot", 1, true)
                        or M:find("safezone", 1, true)
                        or M == "abilities"
                        or M == "enemyprojectiles"
                        or M == "projectiles"
                        or M == "vfxpool"
                        or M == "enemypool"
                        or M == "sfxpool"
                        or M == "enemies"
                        or M == "enemyfolder"
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                    if n:IsA("Model") and n:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        return false
                    end
                    n = n.Parent
                end
                return true
            end
            see.clear = function()
                for entry in pairs(see.a) do
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end)
                    see.a[entry] = nil
                end
                see.hit = nil
            end
            see.step = function(M, n, o)
                see.t = see.t + M
                if see.t >= 0.05 or not see.hit then
                    see.t = 0
                    local hit2 = {}
                    see.ray = see.ray or RaycastParams.new()
                    see.ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    see.ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
                    local position, QF, OF = n.CFrame.Position, {}, { 2, 0, -1.5 }
                    for index, entry in ipairs(OF) do
                        QF[#QF + 1] = (o + Vector3.new(0, entry, 0) - position).Unit
                    end
                    local SF, DF =
                        view.AbsolutePosition + game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset(), view.AbsoluteSize
                    for index2 = 0, 7, 1 do
                        for index3 = 0, 4, 1 do
                            QF[#QF + 1] = n:ViewportPointToRay(
                                SF.X + DF.X * (index2 + 0.5) / 8,
                                SF.Y + DF.Y * (index3 + 0.5) / 5
                            ).Direction.Unit
                        end
                    end
                    SF = (o - position).Magnitude + 3
                    for index4, entry2 in ipairs(QF) do
                        OF, index4 = position, SF
                        for index5 = 1, 5, 1 do
                            DF = contextWorkspace:Raycast(OF, entry2 * index4, see.ray)
                            if not DF then
                                break
                            end
                            index5 = DF.Instance
                            if index5:IsA("Terrain") then
                                break
                            end
                            if see.geo(index5) then
                                if
                                    DF.Normal.Y > 0.7
                                    and (DF.Position.Y < o.Y + 4 or math.min(index5.Size.X, index5.Size.Z) < 10)
                                then
                                    break
                                end
                                hit2[index5] = true
                            end
                            index4 -= (DF.Position - OF).Magnitude + 0.05
                            if index4 <= 0 then
                                break
                            end
                            OF = DF.Position + entry2 * 0.05
                        end
                    end
                    for index6, entry3 in ipairs(contextWorkspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, 1)) do
                        if see.geo(entry3) then
                            hit2[entry3] = true
                        end
                    end
                    see.hit = hit2
                end
                for entry4 in pairs(see.hit) do
                    if not see.a[entry4] then
                        see.a[entry4] = 0
                    end
                end
                n = math.min(1, M * 8)
                for key, entry5 in pairs(see.a) do
                    o = see.hit[key] and (config.map3DSeeAlpha or 0.72) or 0
                    entry5 += (o - entry5) * n
                    if o == 0 and entry5 < 0.02 then
                        see.a[key] = nil
                        pcall(function()
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                        end)
                    else
                        see.a[key] = entry5
                        pcall(function()
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry5
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            zone.see = see
            local M = {
                on = false,
                fov = 70,

            local function n(o)
                if not M.on then
                    return
                end
                local camera = contextWorkspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera or not VF() then
                    return
                end
                local viewportSize, QF = camera.ViewportSize, config.map3DFov or 50
                local OF, camCur = viewportSize.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(QF) * 0.5), config.map3DMaxH or 1200
                local DF, _F = OF / dF * math.clamp(tonumber(config.map3DZoom) or 1, 0.2, 6)
                if DF > camCur then
                    DF, _F =
                        camCur, math.min(math.deg(2 * math.atan(math.tan(math.rad(QF) * 0.5) * DF / camCur)), 110)
                else
                    _F = QF
                end
                QF, OF = zone.camShot(os.clock())
                camCur = zone.camCur
                if not camCur then
                    camCur = {
                        p = QF,
                        y = OF,
                        d = DF,
                        f = _F,
                    }
                    zone.camCur = camCur
                else
                end
                local cF = 1 - math.exp(-(tonumber(o) or 0.016) * 5)
                camCur.p = camCur.p + (QF - camCur.p) * cF
                camCur.y = (camCur.y + ((OF - camCur.y + 180) % 360 - 180) * cF) % 360
                camCur.d = camCur.d + (DF - camCur.d) * math.min(1, cF * 2)
                camCur.f = camCur.f + (_F - camCur.f) * math.min(1, cF * 2)
                cF, QF =
                    view.AbsolutePosition + game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset(),
                    camCur.d * math.tan(math.rad(camCur.f) * 0.5) / math.max(viewportSize.Y * 0.5, 1)
                local DF, _F, uF, mF =
                    (cF.X + x * 0.5 - viewportSize.X * 0.5) * QF,
                    (cF.Y + e * 0.5 - viewportSize.Y * 0.5) * QF,
                    math.rad(camCur.y),
                    N
                OF, QF = mF - math.cos(uF) * DF - math.sin(uF) * _F, K
                local RF, yF =
                    QF + math.sin(uF) * DF - math.cos(uF) * _F, (zone.cy or 0) - (config.map3DGroundDrop or 3)
                if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                end
                if math.abs(camera.FieldOfView - camCur.f) > 0.01 then
                    camera.FieldOfView = camCur.f
                end
                QF, mF = Vector3.new(OF, yF, RF), camCur.p >= 89.4
                if mF then
                    camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                        QF + Vector3.new(0, camCur.d, 0),
                        QF,
                        Vector3.new(-math.sin(uF), 0, -math.cos(uF))
                    )
                else
                    RF, DF = math.rad(math.clamp(camCur.p, 5, 89.4)), Vector3.new(N, zone.cy or yF, K)
                    local transform, OF, _F, mF =
                        CFrame.lookAt(
                            DF
                                + Vector3.new(
                                        math.sin(uF) * math.cos(RF),
                                        math.sin(RF),
                                        math.cos(uF) * math.cos(RF)
                                    )
                                    * camCur.d,
                            DF
                        ),
                        camCur.d / (viewportSize.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(camCur.f) * 0.5)),
                        cF.X + x * 0.5 - viewportSize.X * 0.5,
                        cF.Y + e * 0.5 - viewportSize.Y * 0.5
                    camera.CFrame = transform - transform.RightVector * (_F * OF) + transform.UpVector * (mF * OF)
                end
                cF = config.map3DSeeThrough ~= false
                if cF then
                    pcall(see.step, tonumber(o) or 0.016, camera, Vector3.new(N, zone.cy or yF, K))
                elseif next(see.a) then
                    see.clear()
                end
            end

                C[4].Position, C[4].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(M, x), UDim2.new(1, -M, 0, absoluteSize.Y)
            end

                    rF(NF)
                end)
                p(NF.MouseButton1Up, function()
                    v.down = false
                    rF(NF)
                end)

                    if not success then
                        classicPlus.errors = classicPlus.errors + 1
                        warn("[Classic Plus] Control failed: " .. tostring(kF))
                    end
                    v.down = false
                    rF(NF)
                    kF = I and cF
                    if kF then
                        cF()
                    end
                end)

            end
            local function v(AF, kF)
                local xF = AF and (AF:FindFirstChild(kF))

                    return xF.Value
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function AF(kF, xF)
                if not x(kF) then
                    return "--"
                end
                local aF = kF < 0 and "-" or ""
                kF = math.abs(kF)
                local eF = {
                    { 1000000000000000, "Qa" },
                    { 1000000000000, "T" },
                    { 1000000000, "B" },
                    { 1000000, "M" },
                    { 1000, "K" },
                }
                for index, entry in ipairs(eF) do
                    if kF >= entry[1] then
                        return aF .. string.format("%.2f", kF / entry[1]):gsub("%.?0+$", "") .. entry[2]
                    end
                end
                return aF .. string.format("%." .. tostring(xF or 0) .. "f", kF)
            end
            local function kF()
                now = os.clock()
            end
            local function xF()
                if not writefile then
                    return
                end
                local success, eF = pcall(httpService.JSONEncode, httpService, Z)
                if success then
                    local success3, aF = pcall(writefile, u, eF)
                    if not success3 then
                        warn("[Classic Plus] Could not save preferences: " .. tostring(aF))
                    end
                end
            end
            local function u(V, aF)
                local eF = config2
                if not eF then
                    return
                end
                eF = not g[V]
                if eF then
                    g[V] = {
                        value = config2[V],
                    }
                end
                config2[V] = aF
                s[V] = aF
            end
            local function V(aF, eF)
                if not a(aF, eF) then
                    return
                end
                local a = aF == "palette"
                if a then
                    u("mapAttackOneColor", eF ~= "Default")
                    if eF ~= "Default" then
                        u("mapAttackColor", k[eF])
                    end
                else
                    local k = aF == "mapZoomB"
                    if k then
                        u(aF, eF)
                        local k = not g._zoom
                        if k then
                            g._zoom = {
                                value = n.zoomB,
                            }
                        end
                        n.zoomB = eF
                        s._zoom = eF
                    else
                        u(aF, eF)
                    end
                end
                n.lastAt = 0
            end

                if k then

            end

                    X = H and H.enabled

                        H.setEnabled(Z.smooth)
                    end
                    return
                end

                    eF.minimapBigEvery, eF.minimapEvery = 0, 0

                end
            end

                                        candy.tab = entry2
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return candy.tab
            end
            candy.candies = function()
                local y, success = {}, candy.gameList()
                if success then
                    for key, entry in pairs(success) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and typeof(entry.point) == "Vector3" then
                            y[key] = entry.point
                        end
                    end
                    return y
                end
                for index, child in ipairs(contextWorkspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if child.Name == "Candy" and child:IsA("Model") then
                        success, index = pcall(function()
                            return child:GetPivot().Position
                        end)
                        if success then
                            y[child] = index
                                - Vector3.new(0, tonumber(child:GetAttribute("RestHeight")) or 1.3, 0)
                        end
                    end
                end
                return y
            end
            candy.pick = function(y)
                local now, position = os.clock(), y.Position
                y = candy.candies()
                local function E(vector)
                    return Vector3.new(vector.X - position.X, 0, vector.Z - position.Z).Magnitude
                        + math.abs(vector.Y - position.Y) * 0.5
                end
                local V, p, goalId
                for key, entry in pairs(y) do
                    if not (candy.bad[key] and candy.bad[key] > now) then
                        local v = E(entry)
                        if not V or v < V then
                            V, p, goalId = v, entry, key
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                local w = candy.goalId ~= nil and y[candy.goalId] or nil
                if
                    w
                    and goalId ~= candy.goalId
                    and not (candy.bad[candy.goalId] and candy.bad[candy.goalId] > now)
                    and E(w) - (V or 0) < (config.candySwitch or 8)
                then
                    return w, candy.goalId, (E(w))
                end
                candy.goalId = goalId
                return p, goalId, V
            end
            candy.route = function(y, pathGoal, V)
                local pathAt = os.clock()
                if
                    not (
                        candy.pathFor ~= V
                        or candy.path == nil
                        or candy.pathGoal and (candy.pathGoal - pathGoal).Magnitude > 3
                        or candy.path == false and pathAt - (candy.pathAt or -math.huge) > 2
                    )
                then
                    return true
                end
                candy.pathFor = V
                candy.pathGoal = pathGoal
                candy.pathAt = pathAt
                candy.path = false
                candy.wp = 1
                local p = pathfindingService:CreatePath({
                    AgentRadius = 2,
                    AgentHeight = 5,
                    AgentCanJump = true,
                    WaypointSpacing = 8,
                })
                if
                    pcall(function()
                        p:ComputeAsync(y.Position, pathGoal)
                    end) and p.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success
                then
                    V = p:GetWaypoints()
                    pathAt = V[#V]
                    if
                        pathAt
                        and (
                            Vector3.new(pathAt.Position.X - pathGoal.X, 0, pathAt.Position.Z - pathGoal.Z).Magnitude
                                > 3.5
                            or math.abs(pathAt.Position.Y - pathGoal.Y) > 5
                        )
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                    if #V > 0 then
                        candy.path, candy.wp = V, math.min(2, #V)
                    end
                elseif math.abs(y.Position.Y - pathGoal.Y) > 6 then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            candy.press = function(O, vector)
                local pressAt = os.clock()
                if pressAt - (candy.pressAt or -math.huge) < (config.candyPressEvery or 0.45) then
                    return
                end
                local character = localPlayer.Character
                local E = character and (character:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
                if E and E.Value == true then
                    return

                    ipairs, {
                        localPlayer.Backpack,
                        character,

                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(entry and entry:GetChildren() or {}) do
                        if entry2:IsA("Tool") and u[string.lower(entry2.Name)] then
                            local cooldown, localEvent =
                                entry2:FindFirstChild("cooldown"), entry2:FindFirstChild("localEvent")

                                and localEvent
                                and localEvent:IsA("BindableEvent")
                                and (tonumber(cooldown.Value) or 0) <= 0

                                if vector2.Magnitude > 1 then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        O.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(O.Position, O.Position + vector2)
                                    end)
                                end
                                pcall(function()
                                    localEvent:Fire()
                                end)
                                return

                        end
                    end
                end
            end

                local O = localPlayer.Character
                local humanoid = O and (O:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                local y, progPos =
                    O and (O:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Candy")
                if progPos then

                        candy.got = candy.got + (O - candy.lastCandy)
                    end
                    candy.lastCandy = O
                end
                O = if config.autoCandy ~= true
                    then "Off"
                    else if game.PlaceId ~= 77649408247578
                        then "Waiting for the lobby"
                        else if runtimeState.modHalt or context.MD and context.MD.halted
                            then "Held still by mod detection"
                            else if not (humanoid and y and humanoid.Health > 0)
                                then "Waiting for the character"
                                else nil
                if O then
                    candy.stop()
                    candy.note = O
                    return
                end
                local goal, progFor, progAt = candy.pick(y)
                if not goal then
                    candy.stop()
                    candy.note = "Waiting for the ghosts to throw candy"
                    return
                end
                candy.active = true
                candy.note = ("Going for a candy %d studs away"):format(math.floor(progAt or 0))
                progAt, progPos = os.clock(), y.Position
                if
                    Vector3.new(goal.X - progPos.X, 0, goal.Z - progPos.Z).Magnitude < 3.5
                    and math.abs(progPos.Y - goal.Y) > 6
                then
                    candy.bad[progFor] = progAt + (config.candySkipFor or 60)
                    candy.goalId = nil
                    candy.goal = nil
                    candy.note = "A candy on a roof - skipped"
                    return
                end
                if not candy.progAt or candy.progFor ~= progFor then
                    candy.progPos = progPos
                    candy.progAt = progAt
                    candy.progFor = progFor
                    candy.stalls = 0
                elseif progAt - candy.progAt > 1.5 then
                    if
                        Vector3.new(progPos.X - candy.progPos.X, 0, progPos.Z - candy.progPos.Z).Magnitude
                            < 2
                        and Vector3.new(goal.X - progPos.X, 0, goal.Z - progPos.Z).Magnitude
                            > 3
                    then
                        candy.stalls = candy.stalls + 1
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid.Jump = true
                        end)
                        candy.path = nil
                        if candy.stalls >= 3 then
                            candy.bad[progFor] = progAt + 60
                            candy.goalId = nil
                            candy.stalls = 0
                        end
                    end
                    candy.progPos = progPos
                    candy.progAt = progAt
                end
                if candy.route(y, goal, progFor) == false then
                    candy.bad[progFor] = progAt + (config.candySkipFor or 60)
                    candy.goalId = nil
                    candy.goal = nil
                    candy.path = nil
                    candy.pathFor = nil
                    candy.note = "A candy on a roof - skipped"
                    return
                end
                candy.goal = goal
                candy.press(y, goal)
            end

                if typeof(Z) ~= "Vector3" then
                    return

                if e.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                    return
                end

            pK.laneOut = function(vector, n)
                if config.pkLaneOut == false then
                    return nil
                end
                local o, k = tonumber(config.pkLaneMargin) or 3, {}
                for index, lane in ipairs(pK.lanes) do
                    if n < lane.untilAt then
                        k[#k + 1] = lane
                    end
                end
                if #k == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                local function x(a, e, N, I)
                    local F, C = a - N.o.X, e - N.o.Z
                    e = F * N.ux + C * N.uz
                    if e < -1 or e > N.len + 1 then
                        return false
                    end
                    return math.abs(-F * N.uz + C * N.ux) < N.half + I
                end
                n = nil

                    n = if x(vector.X, vector.Z, entry, o) and (not n or entry.hitAt < n.hitAt) then entry else n
                end

                    return nil

                    -a * n.uz + e * n.ux, -n.uz, n.ux, n.half + o + 0.5, { 1, -1 }, math.huge
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(g) do
                    a = entry2 * C - N

                    entry2 = if pK.redOnPath and pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, e.X, e.Z)
                        then entry2 + 200
                        else entry2
                    entry2 = if pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(e.X, e.Z, 1.5) then entry2 + 150 else entry2
                    if entry2 < i then
                        i, b = entry2, e
                    else
                    end
                end
                return b
            end

            pK.dashOk = function(vector, n, o, k)
                if config.pkCandyDash == false then
                    return false

                local x, a = n.X - vector.X, n.Z - vector.Z
                n = math.sqrt(x * x + a * a)
                local e = math.max(n - (config.pkDashReach or 2.5), 0)
                if e < 0.5 then
                    return true
                end
                local N, I, F = x / n, a / n, math.max(o or 16, 8)
                if pK.redOnPath and pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, vector.X + N * e, vector.Z + I * e) then
                    return false
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.lanes or {}) do
                    if k < entry.untilAt then
                        for index2 = 0, e, 2 do
                            n, index = vector.X + N * index2, vector.Z + I * index2
                            x, index2 = n - entry.o.X, index - entry.o.Z
                            a = x * entry.ux + index2 * entry.uz
                            if
                                a >= -1
                                and a <= entry.len + 1
                                and math.abs(-x * entry.uz + index2 * entry.ux) < entry.half + 3
                            then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(pK.lethal or {}) do
                    if k < entry2.landAt + 0.1 then
                        for index4 = 0, e, 2 do
                            o, x = vector.X + N * index4, vector.Z + I * index4
                            if (o - entry2.p.X) ^ 2 + (x - entry2.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry2.r + O()) ^ 2 then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index5 = 0, e, 2 do
                    if pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(vector.X + N * index5, vector.Z + I * index5, 1.5) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                n = config.pkDashBody or 1.5
                for index6, circle in ipairs(pK.circles) do
                    if k < circle.hitAt + 0.1 then
                        index6, a, x = circle.r + n, vector.X - circle.p.X, vector.Z - circle.p.Z
                        o = a * N + x * I
                        local Z = o * o - (a * a + x * x - index6 * index6)
                        if Z > 0 then
                            local n = -o - math.sqrt(Z)
                            if -o + math.sqrt(Z) > 0 and n < e then
                                if
                                    k + (e + (e - math.max(n, 0))) / F
                                    > circle.hitAt - (config.pkDashMargin or 0.25)
                                then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            v.LineStrike = function(Z)
                pK.firstFan = true
                local n = os.clock()
                if not pK.lineAt or n - pK.lineAt > 5 then
                    pK.fanAt = n
                end
                pK.lineAt = n
                if typeof(Z.origin) == "Vector3" then
                    pK.fanO = Z.origin
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z.dirs or {}) do
                    index, n = ipairs, {
                        entry,
                        -entry,
                    }
                    for key, entry2 in index(n) do
                        Y(
                            "line",
                            Z.origin,
                            entry2,
                            Z.radius,
                            Z.width + 2 * (config.pkFanExtra or 0),
                            q(Z.hitTime) + (config.pkFanAfter or 0.15)
                        )
                        M(
                            Z.origin,
                            entry2,
                            Z.radius,
                            (tonumber(Z.width) or 7) / 2,
                            q(Z.hitTime),
                            q(Z.hitTime) + (config.pkFanAfter or 0.15)
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            v.Trail = function(Z)
                pK.softUntil = math.max(pK.softUntil or 0, q(Z.hitTime) + 0.5)
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z.segments or {}) do
                    local o, k = entry[1], tonumber(entry[2]) or 0
                    if typeof(o) == "CFrame" then
                        p("trail", o, Vector3.new(Z.width + O() * 2, 14, k + O()), false, q(Z.hitTime) + 0.35)
                    end
                end
            end
            v.JackOLanternBreath = function(Z)

                M(Z.origin, n, Z.length, (tonumber(Z.width) or 20) / 2, q(Z.shootStart), q(Z.fireEnd) + 0.2)
            end

                J("head", Y.impact, tonumber(Y.radius) or 30, q(Y.impactTime) + 0.3)

            v.PumpkinRain = function(Y)
                pK.softUntil = math.max(
                    pK.softUntil or 0,
                    q((Y.landTime or 0) + 3 * (Y.ringInterval or 0) + (Y.ringDelay or 0)) + 0.5
                )
                local M, Z = {}, E("PumpkinShockwave")
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z and Z:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    index = entry:GetAttribute("Radius")
                    if index and (entry:IsA("BasePart")) then
                        local k, x = #M + 1, {
                            inner = index,
                        }
                        x.outer, M[k] = math.max(entry.Size.Y, entry.Size.Z) / 2, x
                    end
                end
                table.sort(M, function(n, o)
                    return n.inner < o.inner
                end)
                M = if #M == 0
                    then {
                        {
                            inner = 0,
                            outer = 11.75,
                        },
                        {
                            inner = 26,
                            outer = 29.5,
                        },
                        {
                            inner = 44,
                            outer = 47.5,
                        },
                    }
                    else M
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(Y.impacts or {}) do
                    for index3, entry3 in ipairs(M) do
                        index2 = q((Y.landTime or 0) + (index3 - 1) * (Y.ringInterval or 0) + (Y.ringDelay or 0))
                        Z = index3 == 1 and os.clock() or index2 - (config.pkRingLead or 0.9)
                        if index3 == 1 then
                            J("ring" .. index3, entry2, entry3.outer, index2 + 0.3, Z)
                        else
                            w("ring" .. index3, entry2, entry3.outer, entry3.inner, index2 + 0.3, Z)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            pK.roots = {}
            v.Snapvines = function(w)
                pK.snap[w.id] = tonumber(w.precastRadius) or 8
                local untilAt = tonumber(w.expire) and q(w.expire) or os.clock() + 15
                for key, entry in pairs(w.vines or {}) do
                    if type(entry) == "table" and typeof(entry.base) == "Vector3" then
                        key = tonumber(config.pkVineRootR) or 6
                        J("vine root", entry.base, key, untilAt)
                        table.insert(pK.roots, {
                            p = entry.base,
                            r = key,

                        })

                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pK.nearRoot = function(w, Y, M)
                local now = os.clock()
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.roots or {}) do
                    if
                        now < entry.untilAt
                        and (w - entry.p.X) ^ 2 + (Y - entry.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry.r + (M or 0)) ^ 2
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            v.SnapvineStrike = function(w)
                J("vine", w.target, pK.snap[w.id] or 8, q(w.landed) + 0.3)
                if typeof(w.target) == "Vector3" then
                    table.insert(pK.lethal, {
                        p = w.target,
                        r = pK.snap[w.id] or 12,
                        landAt = q(w.landed),
                        name = "grab circle",

                    while #pK.lethal > 16 do

                    end

            pK.lethalOut = function(vector, Y, M)
                if config.pkLethalOut == false then
                    return nil
                end
                local Z, n = {}
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.lethal) do
                    if M < entry.landAt + 0.1 then
                        Z[#Z + 1] = entry
                        n = if not n and V(vector, entry.p) < entry.r + O() then entry else n
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not n then
                    return nil
                end
                M = n.r + O() + (config.pkLethalOutMargin or 2)
                if
                    Y ~= nil
                    and typeof(Y.point) == "Vector3"
                    and not (Y.label and tostring(Y.label):find("last resort", 1, true))
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.pickedSafe == false)
                    and V(Y.point, n.p) >= M
                then
                    return nil
                end
                Y = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local o = Y and (Y:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                Y = o and (o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or o.PrimaryPart)
                local vector2, x, a = Y and Y.Position, vector.X - n.p.X, vector.Z - n.p.Z
                local e, N, I = x * x + a * a - M * M, math.huge
                for index2 = 0, 15, 1 do
                    o = index2 * 3.141592653589793 / 8
                    index2, Y = math.cos(o), math.sin(o)
                    local C = index2 * x + Y * a
                    local g = C * C - e
                    if g >= 0 then
                        local e = -C + math.sqrt(g)
                        local vector3 = Vector3.new(vector.X + index2 * e, vector.Y, vector.Z + Y * e)
                        local g = (not pK.inside or pK.inside(vector3, 0))
                            and not pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, vector3.X, vector3.Z)
                        for index3, entry2 in ipairs(Z) do
                            g = if g and entry2 ~= n and V(vector3, entry2.p) < entry2.r + O() then false else g
                        end
                        if g and pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(vector3.X, vector3.Z, 1.5) then
                        else
                            if g then
                                local O
                                if vector2 then
                                    local Z, g = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
                                    local i = math.clamp(Z * index2 + g * Y, 0, e)
                                    Z, g = vector.X + index2 * i - vector2.X, vector.Z + Y * i - vector2.Z
                                    O = if (config.pkBossKeep or 0) > 0
                                            and math.sqrt(Z * Z + g * g) < config.pkBossKeep
                                        then e + 25
                                        else e
                                else
                                    O = e
                                end
                                if O < N then
                                    N, I = O, vector3
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not I then
                    o = math.sqrt(x * x + a * a)
                    if o < 0.5 then
                        x, a, o = 1, 0, 1
                    else
                    end
                    I = Vector3.new(n.p.X + x / o * M, vector.Y, n.p.Z + a / o * M)
                else
                end
                return I, n.name
            end
            v.CandyScatter = function(O)
                pK.throwAt = os.clock()
                local w = {
                    landAt = q(O.landTime),
                    endAt = q(O.endTime),
                    pieces = {},
                }
                for index, entry in ipairs(O.candies or {}) do

                        point = entry.point,
                        good = entry.good == true,
                    }
                    if not M.good then
                        M.zone =
                            J("red candy", entry.point, tonumber(config.pkRedR) or 6, w.endAt + 0.5, os.clock())
                    end
                    w.pieces[index] = M
                end
                pK.candy[O.id] = w
            end

                local J = q and q.pieces[O.index]
                if J then
                    J.taken = true
                    if J.zone then
                        J.zone.untilAt = os.clock()
                    end
                end
            end
            v.ArenaShrink = function(O)
                pK.shrink = {
                    start = O.start,

                    holdTime = tonumber(O.holdTime) or 0,
                    inset = tonumber(O.inset) or 0,

            pK.nextFan = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                if pK.throwAt and now - pK.throwAt < 8 and not (pK.fanAt and pK.fanAt > pK.throwAt) then
                    return pK.throwAt + (config.pkFanAfterThrow or 4.5)
                end
                if pK.fanAt then
                    return pK.fanAt + (config.pkFanLoop or 45.1)
                end
                if pK.startAt then
                    return pK.startAt + (config.pkFirstFan or 11.9)
                end
                return nil
            end
            pK.fanWindow = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                if pK.fanAt and now - pK.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2) then
                    return true
                end
                local q = pK.nextFan()
                if not q then
                    return false
                end
                return now >= q - (config.pkFanLead or 3.5) and now <= q + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
            end
            pK.openingHold = function()
                if config.pkOpeningHold == false or pK.firstFan then
                    return false
                end
                local O = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local q = O and (O:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                O = q and (q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                if not O or O.MaxHealth <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                return O.Health >= O.MaxHealth - 1
            end
            pK.redTouch = function(O, q, J, w)
                local now, M, Z, n = os.clock(), tonumber(config.pkRedTouch) or 6, J - O, w - q
                J = Z * Z + n * n
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if not piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                w, index = piece.point.X - O, piece.point.Z - q
                                key = J > 1.0E-6 and math.clamp((w * Z + index * n) / J, 0, 1) or 0
                                local O, q = w - Z * key, index - n * key
                                if key > 0.02 and O * O + q * q < M * M then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            pK.redOnPath = function(O, q, J, w)
                local now, M, Z, n = os.clock(), tonumber(config.pkRedClear) or 6, J - O, w - q
                w = Z * Z + n * n
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if not piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                key, index = piece.point.X - O, piece.point.Z - q
                                J = w > 1.0E-6 and math.clamp((key * Z + index * n) / w, 0, 1) or 0
                                local O, q = key - Z * J, index - n * J
                                if O * O + q * q < M * M then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            pK.greenLive = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function O(pos)
                local J = {}
                pcall(function()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(context.AF.load().accounts or {}) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.enabled ~= false then
                            J[string.lower(tostring(entry.name))] = true
                        end
                    end
                end)
                J[string.lower(localPlayer.Name)] = true
                local w = {}
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(players3:GetPlayers()) do
                    if J[string.lower(entry2.Name)] then
                        index2 = entry2.Character
                        local humanoid, Z =
                            index2 and (index2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                            index2 and (index2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        if entry2 == localPlayer then
                            w[#w + 1] = {
                                name = entry2.Name,
                                pos = pos,
                                me = true,
                            }
                        elseif humanoid and Z and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                            w[#w + 1] = {
                                name = entry2.Name,
                                pos = Z.Position,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(w, function(q, J)
                    return q.name < J.name
                end)
                return w
            end
            pK.goal = function(myCandy)
                local J, w = os.clock(), {}
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if J > entry.endAt + 1 then
                        pK.candy[key] = nil
                    else
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if
                                piece.good
                                and not piece.taken
                                and not piece.skip
                                and J < entry.endAt - 0.2
                                and math.abs(myCandy.Y - 3 - piece.point.Y) <= (config.pkCandyDy or 6)
                                and (
                                    config.pkCandyThorns ~= false
                                        and not (context.pkNoHits and context.pkNoHits())
                                        and pK.inArena(piece.point, 0.5)
                                    or pK.inside(piece.point, 1)
                                )
                            then
                                piece.landAt = entry.landAt
                                local n, aim = tonumber(config.pkRedClear) or 6, piece.point
                                for index2, piece2 in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                                    if not piece2.good and not piece2.taken then
                                        index, index2 =
                                            piece.point.X - piece2.point.X, piece.point.Z - piece2.point.Z
                                        local x = math.sqrt(index * index + index2 * index2)
                                        if x < n + 3.5 and x > 0.3 then
                                            local a = math.min(2.5, n + 3.5 - x)
                                            aim = Vector3.new(
                                                piece.point.X + index / x * a,
                                                piece.point.Y,
                                                piece.point.Z + index2 / x * a
                                            )
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                                local Y = true
                                for index3, piece3 in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                                    if not piece3.good and not piece3.taken and V(aim, piece3.point) < n then
                                        Y = false
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                piece.aim = aim
                                if Y then
                                    w[#w + 1] = {
                                        p = piece,
                                        endAt = entry.endAt,
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #w == 0 then
                    pK.myCandy = nil
                    return nil
                end
                local Y, M, Z, n, o =
                    O(myCandy),
                    tonumber(config.pkCandySpeed) or 16,
                    pK.fanO or Vector3.new(config.pkFanX or 104, 0, config.pkFanZ or 1042)
                if pK.fanAt and J - pK.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2) then
                    n, o = J - 1, pK.fanAt + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
                else
                    if pK.nextFan then
                        myCandy = pK.nextFan()
                        if myCandy and myCandy > J - 1 then
                            n, o = myCandy + (config.pkFanHitAfter or 0.93), myCandy + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                local O, k, x = {}, {}, {}
                for index4, entry2 in ipairs(Y) do
                    O[index4], k[index4] = J, entry2.pos
                end
                J = {}
                for index5 = 1, #w, 1 do
                    J[index5] = true
                end
                myCandy = nil
                for index6 = 1, #w, 1 do
                    local e, N, I
                    for index7, entry3 in ipairs(Y) do
                        for index8, entry4 in ipairs(w) do
                            if J[index8] then
                                index6 = V(k[index7], entry4.p.aim or entry4.p.point)
                                index6 = if entry3.me
                                        and not x[index7]
                                        and pK.myCandy == entry4.p
                                    then math.max(index6 - (config.pkCandyStick or 4), 0)
                                    else index6
                                local C = O[index7] + index6 / M
                                if
                                    o
                                    and (config.pkCandyFanRule == true or context.pkNoHits and context.pkNoHits())
                                then
                                    local a = V(entry4.p.aim or entry4.p.point, Z)
                                    C = if a < (config.pkFanCandyFar or 30)
                                            and C > n - math.max(0, (config.pkFanSafeR or 40) - a) / M - (config.pkFanSpare or 0.6)
                                            and C < o
                                        then o + ((config.pkFanSafeR or 40) + 5 - a) / M
                                        else C
                                else
                                end
                                if
                                    C < entry4.endAt - 0.2
                                    and (
                                        not e
                                        or C < e - 1.0E-6
                                        or math.abs(C - e) <= 1.0E-6
                                            and (index7 < N or index7 == N and index8 < I)
                                    )
                                then
                                    e, N, I = C, index7, index8
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not N then
                        break
                    end
                    J[I] = false
                    O[N], k[N] = e + (config.pkCandyPickT or 0.3), w[I].p.aim or w[I].p.point
                    if not x[N] then
                        x[N] = w[I].p
                        myCandy = if Y[N].me then w[I].p else myCandy
                    else
                    end
                end
                pK.myCandy = myCandy
                return myCandy and (myCandy.aim or myCandy.point) or nil
            end
            local O
            local function q()
                local V = O
                if V then
                    local J = O
                    return J
                end
                V = E("Thornwall")
                local J, w, iterateArray, M, Z =
                    V and tonumber(V:GetAttribute("HalfX")) or 62.42,
                    V and tonumber(V:GetAttribute("HalfZ")) or 41.43,
                    ipairs,
                    {
                        V and (V:FindFirstChild("Vines")),
                        V and (V:FindFirstChild("Thorns")),
                    },
                    0
                for key, entry in iterateArray(M) do
                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(entry and entry:GetChildren() or {}) do
                        V, key =
                            ipairs, {
                                entry2:GetAttribute("A"),
                                entry2:GetAttribute("B"),
                            }
                        for key2, entry3 in V(key) do
                            if typeof(entry3) == "Vector3" then
                                key2 = math.min(J - math.abs(entry3.X), w - math.abs(entry3.Z))
                                    + (tonumber(entry2:GetAttribute("Radius")) or 0.5)
                                Z = if key2 > Z then key2 else Z
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                O = math.clamp(Z, 2, 20)
                w = O
                return w
            end
            local function O()
                local shrink = pK.shrink
                if not shrink then
                    return 0
                end
                local J = y() - (tonumber(shrink.start) or 0)
                if J <= 0 then
                    return 0
                end
                local w, Y =
                    math.clamp(J / shrink.moveTime, 0, 1),
                    math.clamp((J - shrink.moveTime - shrink.holdTime) / shrink.moveTime, 0, 1)
                return shrink.inset * (w * w * (3 - w * 2) - Y * Y * (3 - Y * 2))
            end
            pK.arena = function()
                local bossBarriers = workspace:FindFirstChild("BossBarriers")
                local J, w, Y, M =
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierWest")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierEast")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierNorth")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierSouth"))
                if not (J and w and Y and M) then
                    return nil
                end
                local V, Z, n, o =
                    J.Position.X + J.Size.X / 2,
                    w.Position.X - w.Size.X / 2,
                    Y.Position.Z + Y.Size.Z / 2,
                    M.Position.Z - M.Size.Z / 2
                if V > Z then
                    V, Z = Z, V
                else
                end
                if n > o then
                    n, o = o, n
                else
                end
                return {
                    x0 = V,
                    x1 = Z,
                    z0 = n,
                    z1 = o,
                }
            end
            pK.borderDepth = function()
                local V = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local J = V and (V:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                V = J and (J:GetAttribute("BorderSlamTime"))
                if not V or y() < V then
                    return 0
                end
                V = tonumber(config.pkBorderPad) or 6
                V = if pK.greenLive and pK.greenLive()
                    then math.min(V, tonumber(config.pkBorderPadCandy) or 4)
                    else V

                w = if shrink
                    then if y() - (tonumber(shrink.start) or 0)
                            <= (tonumber(shrink.moveTime) or 2.5)
                                + (tonumber(shrink.holdTime) or 8)
                        then math.max(w, tonumber(shrink.inset) or 0)
                        else w
                    else w
                return q() + w + V
            end
            pK.thornDepth = function()
                local V = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local J = V and (V:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                V = J and (J:GetAttribute("BorderSlamTime"))
                if not V or y() < V then
                    return 0
                end
                return q() + O()
            end
            pK.clamp = function(vector, q)
                local V = pK.arena()
                if not V then
                    return vector
                end
                local J = (q or 0) + pK.borderDepth()
                if V.x1 - V.x0 <= J * 2 or V.z1 - V.z0 <= J * 2 then
                    return vector
                end
                return Vector3.new(
                    math.clamp(vector.X, V.x0 + J, V.x1 - J),
                    vector.Y,
                    math.clamp(vector.Z, V.z0 + J, V.z1 - J)
                )
            end

            end

            pK.border = function(O)

            pK.thornJump = function(O, R)
                local thorn = pK.thorn
                if not thorn then
                    return
                end
                local V = y()
                if V > (thorn.spinEnd or 0) + 0.5 then
                    pK.thorn = nil
                    return
                end
                if V < (thorn.growStart or 0) + 0.45 then
                    return
                end
                local y, E = R.X - thorn.centre.X, R.Z - thorn.centre.Z
                R = math.sqrt(y * y + E * E)
                if R > u() + 3 or R < 2 then
                    return
                end
                local u, J = math.atan2(E, y), tonumber(config.pkThornLead) or 0.18
                local function y(E)
                    return math.clamp(
                        E - (thorn.spinStart or 0),
                        0,
                        (thorn.spinEnd or 0) - (thorn.spinStart or 0)
                    ) * thorn.speed
                end
                local E, w, Y = y(V), y(V + J), math.atan2(2.5, math.max(R, 1))
                for index, angle in ipairs(thorn.angles) do
                    J, index = angle + E, angle + w
                    if index < J then
                        J, index = index, J
                    else
                    end
                    y = u
                    while y < J - Y - 3.141592653589793 do
                        y += 6.283185307179586
                    end
                    while y > J - Y + 3.141592653589793 do
                        y -= 6.283185307179586
                    end
                    if y >= J - Y and y <= index + Y then
                        if O.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                            O.Jump = true
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

                if pK.hooked then
                    return true
                end

                local function u()
                    local iterateArray, y = ipairs, vmHelpers[127](getgc(false))
                    for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(y)) do

                            and islclosure(entry)
                            and tostring(debug.info(entry, "s")):find("EnemyClientEffects", 1, true)
                        if key then
                            local iteratePairs, y = pairs, vmHelpers[127](debug.getupvalues(entry))
                            for key2, entry2 in iteratePairs(vmHelpers:jB(y)) do
                                key2 = type(entry2) == "table"
                                if key2 then
                                    for key3, entry3 in pairs(entry2) do
                                        local q = type(key3) == "string"
                                            and key3:find("Pumpkin King", 1, true)
                                            and type(entry3) == "table"
                                            and type(rawget(entry3, "CandyScatter")) == "function"
                                        if q then
                                            O = entry3
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                entry2 = O
                                if entry2 then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        entry = O
                        if entry then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(u)
                u = not O
                if u then
                    return false
                end
                u = rawget(O, "__hlOrig")
                local R = type(u) ~= "table"
                if R then
                    u = {}
                    rawset(O, "__hlOrig", u)
                else
                end

                    local h = u[entry4] or rawget(O, entry4)
                    R = type(h) == "function"
                    if R then
                        u[entry4] = h
                        index = O

                            local y = v[entry4]

                                local success, V = pcall(y, R, O)
                                if not success then
                                    pK.err = tostring(V)
                                end
                            end
                            return h(O, u, R)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                pK.hooked = true
                if context.log then
                    context.log("PK", "Pumpkin King: reading the boss's attacks")
                end
                return true
            end
