            else
            end
            h.n, h.sum = h.n + 1, h.sum + max
            if max > h.max then
                h.max = max
            end
            if max > 0.004 then
                h.over4 = h.over4 + 1
            end
            if max > 0.008 then
                h.over8 = h.over8 + 1
            end
        end
        runtimeState.stMax = runtimeState.stMax or {}
        local function O(l, u, h)
            local now, R, y = os.clock(), pcall(u, h)
            h = os.clock() - now
            if h > (runtimeState.stMax[l] or 0) then
                runtimeState.stMax[l] = h
            end
            if runtimeState.perf then
                context.perfAdd(runtimeState.perf.cur.stages, l, h)
            end
            if R then
                return
            end
            if l == "brain" then
                U()
            end
            runtimeState.lastError, runtimeState.lastErrorAt = ("%s: %s"):format(l, tostring(y)), os.clock()
            runtimeState.errorLog = runtimeState.errorLog or {}
            h = ("%s: %s"):format(l, tostring(y))
            R = runtimeState.errorLog[h]
            if R then
                R.n, R.last = R.n + 1, os.clock()
            else
                runtimeState.errorLog[h] = {
                    n = 1,
                    first = os.clock(),
                    last = os.clock(),
                }
            end
            if os.clock() - (L[l] or -math.huge) > 5 then
                L[l] = os.clock()
                warn(("[DQ %s] %s: %s"):format(ver, l, tostring(y)))
            end
        end
        local L
        local function l(u)
            if runtimeState.farmEnabled then
                context.brainTick(u)
                if context.redPushApply then
                    context.redPushApply(u)
                end
                if context.spiralGuardApply then
                    context.spiralGuardApply(u)
                end
                if context.unionEscapeApply then
                    context.unionEscapeApply(u)
                end
                if context.orbBounceApply then
                    context.orbBounceApply(u)
                end
                if context.orbPushApply then
                    context.orbPushApply(u)
                end
            else
                U()
                context.setState("off")
            end
            pcall(L, u)
        end
        local u = context.PATH and context.PATH.logs .. "/watch.txt" or "dq_watch.txt"
        pcall(function()
            if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
                local iterateArray, m =
                    ipairs, {
                        u,
                        "dq_watch.txt",
                        (context.PATH and context.PATH.root or "HarvardLabs") .. "/logs/watch.txt",
                    }
                for key, entry in iterateArray(m) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if isfile(entry) then
                            delfile(entry)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
        local h, m, health2 = {}
        local y, q, V, E, p, U, J = 0, false
        L = function(L)
            if config.watchToFile ~= true or config.watchDisabled ~= false then
                return
            end
            if L - (runtimeState.watchAt or 0) < (config.watchSampleEvery or 0.1) then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.watchAt = L
            local w, humanoid, success = context.character()
            if not (humanoid and success) then
                return
            end
            local bubbleBoss, M, Z, n = context.BB, context.RD
            for index, entry in ipairs(M.enemies or {}) do
                if entry.isBoss and entry.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    index = math.sqrt((success.Position.X - entry.x) ^ 2 + (success.Position.Z - entry.z) ^ 2)
                    if not Z or index < Z then
                        Z, n = index, entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            local n = health2 and humanoid.Health < health2 - 1
            if n then
                local f = {}
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.DG.boxes or {}) do
                    local x, a, e =
                        context.depthOf and not entry2.moving and entry2.cx and context.depthOf(
                            entry2,
                            success.Position.X,
                            success.Position.Y,
                            success.Position.Z,
                            context.DG.halfHeight or 4
                        ) or nil,
                        entry2.moving and entry2.ox or entry2.cx,
                        entry2.moving and entry2.oz or entry2.cz
                    if a then
                        local N, I =
                            math.sqrt((success.Position.X - a) ^ 2 + (success.Position.Z - e) ^ 2),
                            x ~= nil and x <= -100000000
                        local a, e =
                            x ~= nil and not I and x >= -12,
                            (entry2.from or 0) <= (context.DG.now or 0)
                                and (entry2.untilAt or math.huge) >= (context.DG.now or 0)
                        if N < 40 or a or I then
                            local F, C = #f + 1, tostring
                            local g, moving = C(entry2.name), entry2.moving
                            index2, C = moving and "/mov" or "", e and ""
                            local k, e =
                                C or "/DEAD",
                                I and " CUT(offhalf-or-height)" or (a and (" INSIDE(depth %.0f)"):format(x) or "")
                            f[F] = ("%s@%.0f%s%s%s"):format(g, N, index2, k, e)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local o, k, health = h, #h + 1, health2
                local a, health3, N, I, F, C, g, i, b, walkSpeed, G, z =
                    health - humanoid.Health,
                    humanoid.Health,
                    bubbleBoss.active and "ON" or "--",
                    bubbleBoss.lethal and "!" or " ",
                    bubbleBoss.count or 0,
                    bubbleBoss.warmCount or 0,
                    bubbleBoss.warnCount or 0,
                    Z and (("%.0f"):format(Z)) or "-",
                    M.leash and "Y" or "n",
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                    tostring(runtimeState.movementState),
                    vmHelpers[127](table.concat(f, " "))
                o[k] = ("HIT -%.0f -> %.0f | bb=%s%s thr=%d/%dwarm/%dyellow bossD=%s leash=%s ws=%.0f | %s | near: %s"):format(
                    a,
                    health3,
                    N,
                    I,
                    F,
                    C,
                    g,
                    i,
                    b,
                    walkSpeed,
                    G,
                    vmHelpers:jB(z)
                )
            end
            health2 = humanoid.Health
            local d, R = success.Position, V
            if R then
                n, success = d.X - V.X, d.Z - V.Z
                local f, o = math.sqrt(n * n + success * success), math.max(L - (E or L), 0.001)
                local k = p and f > 3 and o < 0.6
                if k then
                    local k = math.sqrt(p * p + U * U)
                    local x = k > 0.5
                    if x then
                        local x = (n * p + success * U) / (f * k) < -0.5
                        if x then
                            J = (J or 0) + 1
                            local k = h
                            k[#k + 1] = ("LAGBACK %.1f studs backwards in %.2fs (ws=%.0f, state=%s) total=%d"):format(
                                f,
                                o,
                                humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                                tostring(runtimeState.movementState),
                                J
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
                o = f > 0.2
                if o then
                    local J, o = n / f, success / f
                    p, U = J, o
                end
            end
            V, E = d, L
            d, success = tostring(runtimeState.movementState), L - (runtimeState.wWallAt or 0) >= 0.1
            if success then
                runtimeState.wWallAt = L
                R, n = pairs, M.walls or {}
                for key, entry3 in R(n) do
                    local p = entry3.cx
                    if p then
                        local p, U = key:FindFirstChild("ball1"), key:FindFirstChild("ball2")
                        local J, f, o =
                            p and (p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")),
                            U and (U:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")),
                            math.sqrt(entry3.vx * entry3.vx + entry3.vz * entry3.vz)
                        p, U =
                            o > 0.5 and entry3.ax and math.abs(
                                (entry3.ax * entry3.vx + entry3.az * entry3.vz) / o
                            ) or -1,
                            h
                        U[#U + 1] = ("WALL %7.1f %s c=(%.0f,%.0f) v=(%.1f,%.1f) sp=%.1f halfLen=%.0f axis=(%.2f,%.2f) |axis.v|=%.2f b1=%s b2=%s"):format(
                            L % 100000,
                            key.Name,
                            entry3.cx,
                            entry3.cz,
                            entry3.vx,
                            entry3.vz,
                            o,
                            entry3.halfLen or -1,
                            entry3.ax or 0,
                            entry3.az or 0,
                            p,
                            J and ("(%.0f,%.0f)"):format(J.Position.X, J.Position.Z) or "?",
                            f and ("(%.0f,%.0f)"):format(f.Position.X, f.Position.Z) or "?"
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            R = d ~= m or L - y > 2
            if R then
                m = d
                n = h
                n[#n + 1] = ("%7.1f hp=%3.0f%% ws=%2.0f bb=%s%s thr=%d bossD=%s leash=%s | %s"):format(
                    L % 100000,
                    humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1) * 100,
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                    bubbleBoss.active and "ON" or "--",
                    bubbleBoss.lethal and "!" or " ",
                    bubbleBoss.count or 0,
                    Z and ("%.0f"):format(Z) or "-",
                    M.leash and "Y" or "n",
                    d
                )
            end
            d = L - y > 2 and #h > 0
            if d then
                y = L
                success = pcall(function()
                    local d = not q
                    if d then
                        if not (isfile and isfile(u)) then
                            writefile(u, "")
                        end
                        q = true
                    end
                    appendfile(u, table.concat(h, "\10") .. "\10")
                end)
                if success then
                    h = {}
                else
                    M = #h > 400
                    if M then
                        h = {}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        runtimeState.streamerConnection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if runtimeState.destroyed then
                return
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            pcall(r, now)
            local streamer = os.clock() - now
            if runtimeState.stMax and streamer > (runtimeState.stMax.streamer or 0) then
                runtimeState.stMax.streamer = streamer
            end
        end)
        if config.perfProbe ~= false and not context.NOVIS then
            local function d(L, u, h)
                local m = L and L[u]
                if type(m) ~= "function" or L["__perf_" .. u] then
                    return
                end
                L["__perf_" .. u] = m
                L[u] = function(...)
                    local now, u, R, y, q = os.clock(), m(...)
                    if runtimeState.perf then
                        context.perfAdd(runtimeState.perf.cur.fns, h, os.clock() - now)
                    end
                    return u, R, y, q
                end
            end
            if context.BB then
                success2 = {
                    "tick",
                    "pathTouchesRed",
                    "orbPathSafe",
                    "route",
                    "detour",
                    "yellowAt",
                    "orbLaneHit",
                    "blueBeams",
                    "onBlueBeam",
                    "orbCrossIn",
                    "orbArrive",
                    "redRoute",
                    "pathBlocked",
                }
                for index29, entry32 in ipairs(success2) do
                    d(context.BB, entry32, "BB." .. entry32)
                end
            end
            bugButton = { "spiralList", "spiralArms", "spiralWalkBad", "spiralRedOn", "groupPlan" }
            for index30, entry33 in ipairs(bugButton) do
                d(context, entry33, entry33)
            end
        end
        runtimeState.mainConnection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if runtimeState.destroyed then
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.modHalt then
                return
            end
            local d = os.clock()
            local perf, cur = runtimeState.perf
            if perf then
                local wasRodin = hazardReader.rodinRig ~= nil and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent ~= nil
                if perf.wasRodin and not wasRodin and not context.NOVIS then
                    pcall(function()
                        local P, u =
                            (context.PATH and context.PATH.logs or "HarvardLabs/logs") .. "/perf_rodin.jsonl",
                            game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
                                ver = ver,
                                at = os.time(),
                                set = perf.sets.rodin,
                            })
                        if appendfile and isfile and isfile(P) then
                            appendfile(P, u .. "\10")
                        elseif writefile then
                            writefile(P, u .. "\10")
                        end
                    end)
                    perf.sets.rodin = perf.newSet()
                end
                perf.wasRodin = wasRodin
                cur = wasRodin and perf.sets.rodin or perf.sets.other
                perf.cur = cur
                if d - (perf.pingAt or 0) > 1 then
                    perf.pingAt = d
                    local max, ping = (runtimeState.pingS or 0) * 1000, cur.ping
                    ping.n, ping.sum = ping.n + 1, ping.sum + max
                    if max > ping.max then
                        ping.max = max
                    end
                    if max > 150 then
                        ping.over150 = ping.over150 + 1
                    end
                    if max > 300 then
                        ping.over300 = ping.over300 + 1
                    end
                end
                if not context.NOVIS and d - (perf.savedAt or 0) > 10 then
                    perf.savedAt = d
                    pcall(function()
                        if writefile then
                            writefile(
                                (context.PATH and context.PATH.logs or "HarvardLabs/logs") .. "/perf.json",
                                game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
                                    ver = ver,
                                    secs = d - perf.since,
                                    sets = perf.sets,
                                })
                            )
                        end
                    end)
                end
                wasRodin = cur.frames
                local P = d - (wasRodin.last or d)
                wasRodin.last, wasRodin.n = d, wasRodin.n + 1
                if P > wasRodin.maxGap then
                    wasRodin.maxGap = P
                end
                if P > 0.05 then
                    wasRodin.gap50 = wasRodin.gap50 + 1
                end
                if P > 0.1 then
                    wasRodin.gap100 = wasRodin.gap100 + 1
                    if P > 0.25 then
                        wasRodin.gap250 = wasRodin.gap250 + 1
                    end
                    local spikes = wasRodin.spikes
                    local h, m =
                        #spikes + 1, {
                            at = d - perf.since,
                            gap = P,
                            work = wasRodin.lastWork or 0,
                        }
                    m.state, spikes[h] = tostring(runtimeState.movementState or ""):sub(1, 70), m
                    if #spikes > 40 then
                        table.remove(spikes, 1)
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            local mainLoop = config.tickHz or 0
            if mainLoop > 0 then
                if runtimeState.lastTickAt and d - runtimeState.lastTickAt < 1 / mainLoop then
                    return
                end
                runtimeState.lastTickAt = d
            end
            O("reader", context.readerTick, d)
            O("lobby", context.lobbyTick, d)
            O("config", context.autosaveTick, d)
            O("range", context.judgeCasts, d)
            O("buffs", context.buffTick, d)
            O("brain", l, d)
            O("caster", context.casterTick, d)
            O("face", context.faceTick, d)
            runtimeState.econN = (runtimeState.econN or 0) + 1
            if
                not (
                    config.lowEndEconomy ~= false
                    and (runtimeState.tickMs or 0) > (config.lowEndLoad or 2)
                    and runtimeState.econN % 2 == 0
                )
            then
                O("draw", context.drawTick, d)
            end
            mainLoop = os.clock() - d
            if mainLoop > (runtimeState.stMax.mainLoop or 0) then
                runtimeState.stMax.mainLoop = mainLoop
            end
            runtimeState.tickMs = runtimeState.tickMs * 0.9 + (os.clock() - d) * 100
            if cur then
                local Q, work = os.clock() - d, cur.work
                work.n, work.sum = work.n + 1, work.sum + Q
                if Q > work.max then
                    work.max = Q
                end
                if Q > 0.008 then
                    work.over8 = work.over8 + 1
                end
                if Q > 0.016 then
                    work.over16 = work.over16 + 1
                end
                if Q > 0.033 then
                    work.over33 = work.over33 + 1
                end
                cur.frames.lastWork = Q
            end
        end)
    end

    return components
end)()

return components
end)()

local context = {}
components.coreSettings(context)
context.loadConfig()
components.inventoryAutomation(context)
components.uiLibrary(context)
components.interfaceMainLoop(context)

return context
